words.note: plumber 的 b 不發音，唸起來像 PLUM-er。plumbing＝水管系統、水電工程。注意：plumber 主要修「水管」；修「電」的是 electrician（電工）。長很像的字：plunger（通馬桶的吸盤）、lumber（木材）。

words.meaning: 不當地；不正確地；不恰當地

sentences.en: The shipment was damaged because the boxes had been packed improperly at the warehouse in Busan last week.
sentences.zh: 這批貨受損了，因為上週在釜山倉庫打包得不正確。

sentences.en: Employees who use the company credit card improperly may lose their spending privileges and face disciplinary action.
sentences.zh: 不當使用公司信用卡的員工，可能會被取消使用權限並受到懲處。

sentences.en: If the machine is installed improperly, the warranty will not cover any of the repair costs.
sentences.zh: 如果機器安裝不當，保固將不會負擔任何維修費用。

sentences.en: Several customers complained that their personal information had been handled improperly by the call center.
sentences.zh: 有幾位客戶抱怨客服中心不當處理他們的個人資料。

sentences.en: Food that is stored improperly can spoil quickly, especially in the kitchen during the hot summer months.
sentences.zh: 保存方式不對的食物很快就會壞掉，尤其是炎熱夏天放在廚房的時候。

words.note: improperly＝im（不）＋ properly（正確地、適當地），意思剛好相反。形容詞是 improper（不當的）。多益常見搭配：installed improperly（安裝不當）、stored improperly（保存不當）、used improperly（使用不當）。

sentences.en: Please do not heat fish in the office microwave because the smell spreads through the entire floor.
sentences.zh: 請不要用辦公室的微波爐加熱魚，因為味道會傳遍整層樓。

sentences.en: The staff kitchen has a refrigerator, a coffee maker, and a microwave for employees to use during lunch.
sentences.zh: 員工廚房有冰箱、咖啡機和微波爐，午餐時間可以使用。

sentences.en: Our new microwave oven model heats food twice as fast as the previous version while using less power.
sentences.zh: 我們的新款微波爐加熱速度是舊款的兩倍，而且更省電。

sentences.en: Customers who purchase a microwave this week will receive a free set of plastic food containers for reheating meals.
sentences.zh: 本週購買微波爐的顧客，會免費獲得一組加熱餐點用的塑膠保鮮盒。

sentences.en: The maintenance team removed the broken microwave from the staff kitchen because it stopped heating food properly.
sentences.zh: 維修團隊把員工廚房壞掉的微波爐搬走了，因為它沒辦法正常加熱食物。

words.note: microwave oven 就是微波爐，口語通常只說 microwave。microwave 也可以當動詞：microwave the soup（用微波爐熱湯）。micro- 是「微小」的意思，所以 microphone（麥克風）、microscope（顯微鏡）長得很像。

sentences.en: The manager made a brief announcement about the new parking rules at the start of the meeting.
sentences.zh: 經理在會議一開始簡短宣布了新的停車規定。

sentences.en: Each candidate will give a brief presentation of no more than five minutes about their sales experience.
sentences.zh: 每位應徵者要做一個不超過五分鐘的簡短報告，介紹自己的業務經驗。

sentences.en: Please keep your email brief and include only the most important details for the client.
sentences.zh: 信請寫得簡短一點，只放客戶需要的重點就好。

sentences.en: After a brief pause, the speaker continued her talk about the company's plans for next year.
sentences.zh: 講者短暫停頓後，繼續談公司明年的計畫。

sentences.en: There will be a brief delay in shipping because of the national holiday on Monday.
sentences.zh: 因為週一是國定假日，出貨會稍微延遲一下。

words.note: brief 可以指「時間短」（a brief meeting）或「話說得少」（a brief email）。副詞是 briefly（簡短地）。同義詞：short。brief 也可以當名詞或動詞：brief the team（向團隊簡報），briefing＝簡報會。

sentences.en: I'm running late because of heavy traffic this morning, so please start the weekly meeting without me.
sentences.zh: 今天早上塞車，我會晚到，請先開始每週例會，不用等我。

sentences.en: The train is running late this morning, and passengers are advised to check the updated schedule online.
sentences.zh: 火車今天早上誤點，建議乘客上網查詢最新時刻表。

sentences.en: If you are running late for your interview, call the receptionist as soon as possible to let her know.
sentences.zh: 如果你面試會遲到，請盡快打電話告訴櫃檯人員。

sentences.en: The conference is running late, so the lunch break will begin twenty minutes after the scheduled time.
sentences.zh: 會議進度落後，所以午休會比原定時間晚二十分鐘開始。

sentences.en: Ms. Lopez texted the client to say she was running late because her flight had been delayed.
sentences.zh: 羅培茲小姐傳訊息給客戶，說她的班機延誤，所以會晚一點到。

words.note: be running late＝「（還在路上）會晚到、時程落後」，通常是事前先告知別人；be late 是單純「遲到了」。別搞混：running out（快用完）、running into（巧遇）。

words.meaning: 之前的；先前的（prior to＝在……之前）

sentences.en: All visitors must register at the front desk on the first floor prior to entering the research laboratory.
sentences.zh: 所有訪客進入研究實驗室前，必須先到一樓櫃檯登記。

sentences.en: Please submit your expense reports at least three days prior to the end of each month.
sentences.zh: 請在每個月底前至少三天交出費用報告。

sentences.en: No prior experience is required for this sales position because full training will be provided by our team.
sentences.zh: 這個業務職位不需要相關經驗，我們團隊會提供完整訓練。

sentences.en: The hotel requires guests to cancel their reservations 48 hours prior to arrival to avoid a fee.
sentences.zh: 飯店要求房客在入住前 48 小時取消訂房，才不會被收費。

sentences.en: Prior to joining our company, Mr. Tan worked as a sales manager in Singapore for six years.
sentences.zh: 陳先生加入我們公司前，在新加坡當了六年業務經理。

words.note: prior to＝before（在……之前），但比較正式，常出現在公告、合約、email。prior 單獨用是「之前的」，例如 prior experience（相關經驗）、prior notice（事先通知）。名詞 priority 是「優先事項」。

sentences.en: The community center offers a soapmaking class where participants learn to mix natural oils and scents.
sentences.zh: 社區中心開了一堂手工皂課，學員會學習調配天然油脂和香味。

sentences.en: She started a small soapmaking business at home and now sells handmade bars to local hotels.
sentences.zh: 她在家開了小小的手工皂事業，現在把手工肥皂賣給當地的飯店。

sentences.en: Our annual team-building event this Friday will include a soapmaking workshop using lavender and honey.
sentences.zh: 今年這週五的團隊活動，會有一場用薰衣草和蜂蜜做手工皂的工作坊。

sentences.en: Because soapmaking involves chemicals such as lye, all students must wear gloves and safety glasses.
sentences.zh: 因為做肥皂會用到鹼液這類化學品，所有學員都必須戴手套和護目鏡。

sentences.en: The factory tour ends in the gift shop, where visitors can watch a soapmaking demonstration.
sentences.zh: 工廠導覽最後會到禮品店，遊客可以在那裡看做肥皂的示範。

words.note: soapmaking＝soap（肥皂）＋making（製作）。英文常用「東西＋making」表示做某種東西：papermaking（造紙）、winemaking（釀酒）、filmmaking（拍電影）。手工皂可以說 handmade soap。

words.meaning: 值得注意的；顯著的；著名的

sentences.en: The awards ceremony recognized several notable performances by young actors and musicians from across the country.
sentences.zh: 頒獎典禮表揚了幾場來自全國各地年輕演員和音樂家的出色表演。

sentences.en: One notable change in this year's budget is the increase in funding for employee training programs.
sentences.zh: 今年預算中一個值得注意的改變，是員工訓練計畫的經費增加了。

sentences.en: The museum's new exhibit includes paintings by several notable artists from the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries.
sentences.zh: 博物館的新展覽有幾位十九世紀末到二十世紀初知名畫家的作品。

sentences.en: Ms. Wu's most notable achievement was doubling the company's sales in Asia within two years.
sentences.zh: 吳小姐最顯著的成就，是在兩年內讓公司在亞洲的業績翻倍。

sentences.en: The hotel is located near many notable landmarks, including the old city hall and the central market.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店鄰近許多著名地標，包括舊市政廳和中央市場。

words.note: notable＝note（注意）＋able（值得），「值得注意的、出色的、有名的」。副詞 notably（特別是；顯著地）。容易搞混：noticeable 是「看得出來的、明顯的」，notable 更強調「重要、值得一提」。同義詞：remarkable、outstanding。

sentences.en: A spokesperson for the airline confirmed that all flights to Tokyo would resume on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 航空公司發言人證實，飛往東京的所有航班將在週一早上恢復。

sentences.en: The company's spokesperson answered reporters' questions about the product recall during a short press conference.
sentences.zh: 公司發言人在簡短的記者會上回答了記者關於產品召回的問題。

sentences.en: According to a hospital spokesperson, the new emergency wing will open to patients next spring.
sentences.zh: 根據醫院發言人的說法，新的急診大樓明年春天會開始服務病患。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin was chosen as the official spokesperson because she speaks clearly and handles pressure well.
sentences.zh: 林小姐被選為正式發言人，因為她說話清楚、抗壓性也好。

sentences.en: The city government has not yet appointed a new spokesperson since Mr. Ortiz retired last month.
sentences.zh: 奧提茲先生上個月退休後，市政府還沒任命新的發言人。

words.note: spokesperson＝spoke（說，speak 的過去式）＋person（人），代表公司或政府對外說話的人。以前常說 spokesman（男）／spokeswoman（女），現在多用不分性別的 spokesperson。常見搭配：a spokesperson for…（……的發言人）、press conference（記者會）。

sentences.en: Please call the restaurant beforehand if you would like to reserve a private room for the team dinner.
sentences.zh: 如果團隊聚餐想訂包廂，請事先打電話給餐廳。

sentences.en: All presenters are asked to send their slides to the event organizer at least two days beforehand.
sentences.zh: 所有講者都必須至少提前兩天把投影片寄給活動主辦人。

sentences.en: If you cannot attend the training session on Friday, please let your manager know beforehand by email.
sentences.zh: 如果你週五不能參加訓練課，請事先寄信告訴你的主管。

sentences.en: The hotel requires payment beforehand for all large group bookings of more than ten rooms during the holidays.
sentences.zh: 假日期間超過十間房的團體訂房，飯店都要求預先付款。

sentences.en: We checked the projector beforehand so that the client presentation would start without any problems.
sentences.zh: 我們事先檢查了投影機，讓客戶簡報能順利開始。

words.note: beforehand＝事先（在某件事發生之前先做好），通常放在句尾，例如 let me know beforehand。同義詞：in advance、ahead of time。相反詞：afterward（之後）。和 prior to 不同：prior to 後面要接名詞（prior to the meeting），beforehand 單獨用就好。

sentences.en: You'll need to arrange for someone to drive you home afterwards since your vision will be blurry for a few hours.
sentences.zh: 你需要安排別人之後載你回家，因為你的視力會模糊幾個小時。

sentences.en: The workshop ends at noon, and lunch will be served in the main hall afterwards.
sentences.zh: 研習中午結束，之後會在大廳供應午餐。

sentences.en: Please read the contract carefully this morning and send me any comments afterwards by email.
sentences.zh: 請今天早上仔細看過合約，之後再用電子郵件把意見寄給我。

sentences.en: The manager gave a short speech, and afterwards the new employees introduced themselves to the team.
sentences.zh: 經理簡短致詞後，新進員工接著向團隊自我介紹。

sentences.en: Guests can tour the factory first and enjoy a free tasting session in the gift shop afterwards.
sentences.zh: 來賓可以先參觀工廠，之後在禮品店享受免費試吃。

words.note: afterwards（英式常見）＝afterward（美式常見），意思一樣：之後、後來。相反詞是 beforehand（事先）。常和 since 一起出現時要注意：since 在這裡是「因為」，不是「自從」。

sentences.en: The photos on the company website look blurry, so we need to replace them with clearer images.
sentences.zh: 公司網站上的照片看起來很模糊，我們需要換成比較清楚的圖片。

sentences.en: After the eye exam, your vision may be blurry for a few hours, so please do not drive.
sentences.zh: 眼睛檢查後，你的視力可能會模糊幾個小時，所以請不要開車。

sentences.en: The text on the projector screen was too blurry for the people in the back row to read.
sentences.zh: 投影幕上的字太模糊了，坐後排的人看不清楚。

sentences.en: If the scanned copy of your passport is blurry, the visa office will ask you to send it again.
sentences.zh: 如果護照掃描檔很模糊，簽證辦公室會請你重寄一次。

sentences.en: The security camera recorded only a blurry image of the delivery truck leaving the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 監視器只拍到送貨卡車離開倉庫的模糊畫面。

words.note: blurry＝模糊的（照片、視線、字）。動詞是 blur（使模糊），blurred 也是「模糊的」，意思差不多。相反詞：clear（清楚的）、sharp（清晰的）。長很像的字：furry（毛茸茸的）。

words.meaning: 在……之後；（形容詞）接下來的；以下的

sentences.en: Your vision may be blurry for about twenty minutes following the eye exam, so please rest in the waiting room.
sentences.zh: 眼睛檢查後大約二十分鐘內，視力可能會模糊，請在候診室休息。

sentences.en: A light lunch will be served in the cafeteria immediately following the board meeting on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 週四董事會一結束，員工餐廳會供應簡單的午餐。

sentences.en: Sales increased sharply in the three months following the official launch of our new mobile app.
sentences.zh: 新手機 App 正式推出後的三個月，銷售量大幅成長。

sentences.en: Customers will receive a short satisfaction survey by email on the day following their delivery.
sentences.zh: 顧客會在收到貨的隔天，收到一份簡短的滿意度問卷電子郵件。

sentences.en: The question-and-answer session following the sales presentation will last about thirty minutes in Room B.
sentences.zh: 業務簡報結束後的問答時間，會在 B 會議室進行約三十分鐘。

words.note: following 當介系詞＝after（在……之後），比較正式，公告、醫療說明、新聞很常用。也可以當形容詞「接下來的、以下的」：the following day（隔天）、the following items（以下項目）。

sentences.en: Given your history of vision issues, we recommend a full eye exam once every six months.
sentences.zh: 考慮到你有視力問題的病史，我們建議每六個月做一次完整的眼睛檢查。

sentences.en: Given the bad weather, the outdoor company picnic has been moved to the conference hall.
sentences.zh: 考慮到天氣不好，公司戶外野餐改到會議廳舉行。

sentences.en: Given her ten years of sales experience, Ms. Lee is the best candidate for the manager position.
sentences.zh: 考慮到李小姐有十年業務經驗，她是經理職位的最佳人選。

sentences.en: The project was finished on time, which is impressive given the small size of the team.
sentences.zh: 專案準時完成了，考慮到團隊人數很少，這相當了不起。

sentences.en: Given the high demand this season, customers should place their orders at least two weeks in advance.
sentences.zh: 考慮到這一季需求很高，顧客應該至少提前兩週下單。

words.note: given 當介系詞＝considering（考慮到、鑑於），後面接名詞，常放句首：Given the weather, …。也可以接句子：given (that) …。別跟動詞 give 的過去分詞 given（被給予）搞混，例如 I was given a gift（我收到禮物）。

words.meaning: 論壇；討論會；（網路）討論區

sentences.en: The city will hold a public forum next Tuesday to discuss plans for the new train station.
sentences.zh: 市政府下週二會舉辦公聽會，討論新火車站的計畫。

sentences.en: Employees are encouraged to share ideas for improving the workplace on the company's internal online forum.
sentences.zh: 公司鼓勵員工在內部網路討論區分享改善工作環境的想法。

sentences.en: More than two hundred business leaders attended the economic forum held in Singapore last month.
sentences.zh: 上個月在新加坡舉辦的經濟論壇，有兩百多位企業領袖出席。

sentences.en: The customer support forum allows users to ask questions and help each other solve technical problems.
sentences.zh: 客服討論區讓使用者可以發問，並互相幫忙解決技術問題。

sentences.en: The annual forum gives small business owners a chance to meet investors and learn from industry experts.
sentences.zh: 這個年度論壇讓小企業老闆有機會認識投資人，並向業界專家學習。

words.note: forum 可以是實體的「論壇、公聽會」（public forum），也可以是網路的「討論區」（online forum，例如 PTT、Dcard、Reddit）。相近的字：seminar（研討會）、conference（大型會議）。長很像的字：formula（公式；配方）。

words.meaning: 招待會；歡迎會；接待處（櫃檯）；（手機）收訊

sentences.en: We will be hosting a small reception at noon to welcome our new partners from Japan.
sentences.zh: 我們中午會舉辦一場小型招待會，歡迎來自日本的新合作夥伴。

sentences.en: Please leave your visitor badge at the reception desk on the first floor before you leave the building.
sentences.zh: 離開大樓前，請把訪客證交還到一樓的接待櫃檯。

sentences.en: A wedding reception will be held in the hotel's garden, followed by dinner in the main ballroom.
sentences.zh: 婚宴會在飯店花園舉行，之後在大宴會廳用晚餐。

sentences.en: The mobile phone reception inside the warehouse is poor, so workers often use radios to communicate.
sentences.zh: 倉庫裡的手機收訊很差，所以工人常用無線電溝通。

sentences.en: The new manager received a warm reception from her team on her first day at the office.
sentences.zh: 新經理上班第一天就受到團隊熱情的歡迎。

words.note: reception 的意思很多：招待會、歡迎會（welcome reception、wedding reception 婚宴）；接待處、櫃檯（reception desk，櫃檯人員叫 receptionist）；手機收訊（good reception）；受到的反應（a warm reception 熱烈歡迎）。長很像的字：receipt（收據）、recipe（食譜）。

words.meaning: 花的；花卉的；有花朵圖案的

sentences.en: The hotel lobby was decorated with fresh floral arrangements for this week's international business conference.
sentences.zh: 為了這週的國際商務會議，飯店大廳用新鮮的花藝擺設裝飾。

sentences.en: Our new spring collection features light dresses with colorful floral patterns made from soft cotton fabrics.
sentences.zh: 我們的春季新品有輕盈的洋裝，用柔軟的棉布做成，上面有彩色的花朵圖案。

sentences.en: The florist will deliver the floral decorations to the wedding reception venue by ten o'clock.
sentences.zh: 花店會在十點前把花卉裝飾送到婚宴場地。

sentences.en: Customers say the new hand soap has a pleasant floral scent that is not too strong.
sentences.zh: 顧客說新的洗手乳有淡淡的、宜人的花香，不會太濃。

sentences.en: Ms. Tan started a small floral design business that supplies flowers to restaurants and hotels downtown.
sentences.zh: 陳小姐開了一家小型花藝設計公司，提供鮮花給市中心的餐廳和飯店。

words.note: floral 是 flower（花）的形容詞：floral arrangement（花藝擺設）、floral pattern（花朵圖案）、floral scent（花香）。賣花、插花的人叫 florist（花店老闆、花藝師）。長很像的字：moral（道德的）。

words.meaning: （花草）枯萎；凋謝；（人）變得無精打采

sentences.en: Fresh flowers in the hotel lobby begin to wilt after three days, so the staff replace them every Monday and Thursday.
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳的鮮花三天後就開始枯萎，所以員工每週一和週四都會換新。

sentences.en: Without enough water, the plants in the office will wilt quickly during the hot summer months.
sentences.zh: 沒有足夠的水，辦公室的植物在炎熱的夏天很快就會枯萎。

sentences.en: Store the lettuce in the refrigerator so that it does not wilt before the lunch buffet tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 把萵苣放進冰箱，這樣明天午餐自助餐前才不會軟掉。

sentences.en: The florist sprays the roses with cold water to keep them from starting to wilt in the shop window.
sentences.zh: 花店老闆用冷水噴玫瑰，避免它們在櫥窗裡開始凋謝。

sentences.en: Many workers begin to wilt in the afternoon heat, so the factory provides cold drinks and extra breaks.
sentences.zh: 很多工人在下午的高溫下開始沒精神，所以工廠提供冷飲和額外的休息時間。

words.note: wilt 是花草因為缺水或太熱而「垂下來、軟掉」，也可以形容人累到沒精神。過去式 wilted（枯萎的）。相近的字：wither（枯萎，程度更嚴重、乾掉）、fade（褪色、凋謝）。

sentences.en: The annual awards banquet will be held in the hotel's grand ballroom on Friday evening.
sentences.zh: 年度頒獎晚宴將於週五晚上在飯店的大宴會廳舉行。

sentences.en: More than three hundred guests attended the formal banquet held to celebrate the company's fiftieth anniversary.
sentences.zh: 三百多位賓客出席了慶祝公司五十週年的正式晚宴。

sentences.en: The banquet hall can seat up to five hundred people and is often used for weddings and conferences.
sentences.zh: 這間宴會廳最多可以容納五百人，常用來辦婚禮和會議。

sentences.en: Please confirm your meal choice for the banquet by Wednesday so that the kitchen can prepare enough food.
sentences.zh: 請在週三前確認你晚宴的餐點選擇，讓廚房能準備足夠的食物。

sentences.en: The mayor gave a short speech at the banquet to thank the volunteers for their hard work.
sentences.zh: 市長在宴會上簡短致詞，感謝志工的辛勞。

words.note: banquet 是比較正式、人很多的宴會，通常有致詞、頒獎，例如尾牙、頒獎晚宴。reception 是比較輕鬆的招待會（站著聊天、吃點心）。長很像的字：bouquet（花束）。

words.meaning: （宣傳、行銷）活動；運動；競選活動

sentences.en: The marketing team launched a new advertising campaign to promote our summer drinks on social media.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊在社群媒體上推出新的廣告活動，宣傳我們的夏季飲品。

sentences.en: The company's recycling campaign encouraged employees to reduce paper use by thirty percent this year.
sentences.zh: 公司的回收活動鼓勵員工今年減少三成的用紙量。

sentences.en: Thanks to the successful online campaign, sales of the new headphones doubled within two months.
sentences.zh: 多虧網路行銷活動很成功，新耳機的銷量在兩個月內翻倍。

sentences.en: Ms. Ito will lead the fundraising campaign for the new children's hospital starting early next month.
sentences.zh: 伊藤小姐將從下個月初開始，負責新兒童醫院的募款活動。

sentences.en: The city started a safety campaign to remind drivers to slow down near schools and parks.
sentences.zh: 市政府發起交通安全宣導活動，提醒駕駛在學校和公園附近減速。

words.note: campaign 是「為了某個目標、持續一段時間的一系列活動」，例如 advertising／marketing campaign（廣告／行銷活動）、fundraising campaign（募款活動）、election campaign（競選活動）。常搭配動詞 launch（推出）。發音 kam-PAIN，g 不發音。長很像的字：champagne（香檳）。

words.meaning: （努力）有了回報；成功了；還清（債務）

sentences.en: All the long hours the team spent preparing the proposal finally paid off when the client signed the contract.
sentences.zh: 團隊花了很多時間準備提案，客戶簽約時終於有了回報。

sentences.en: Our decision to invest in online advertising paid off, as sales rose by forty percent last quarter.
sentences.zh: 我們投資網路廣告的決定成功了，上一季業績成長了四成。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin's hard work paid off when she was promoted to regional manager after only two years.
sentences.zh: 林小姐的努力有了回報，才兩年就升上區域經理。

sentences.en: The extra training sessions for new staff paid off, and customer complaints dropped sharply this month.
sentences.zh: 新員工的額外訓練見效了，這個月客訴大幅減少。

sentences.en: Moving the factory closer to the port paid off by cutting shipping times in half.
sentences.zh: 把工廠搬到靠近港口的地方很值得，運送時間縮短了一半。

words.note: pay off（過去式 paid off）主要有兩個意思：①努力、投資「有回報、成功了」：Hard work pays off.（努力會有回報）②還清債務：pay off a loan。別搞混：laid off＝被裁員；paid back＝還錢給某人。

words.meaning: 高峰會；（山的）山頂；最高點

sentences.en: Leaders from twenty countries will gather in Seoul next month for an international economic summit.
sentences.zh: 二十個國家的領袖下個月將齊聚首爾，參加國際經濟高峰會。

sentences.en: The climbers reached the summit of the mountain just before sunrise and took photos of the view.
sentences.zh: 登山客在日出前登上山頂，拍下了風景。

sentences.en: The technology summit attracted more than two thousand engineers, investors, and business owners from around the world this year.
sentences.zh: 今年的科技高峰會吸引了來自世界各地兩千多位工程師、投資人和企業主。

sentences.en: Our CEO was invited to speak about green energy at the business summit in Geneva.
sentences.zh: 我們的執行長受邀在日內瓦的商業高峰會上談綠能。

sentences.en: Hotel rooms near the convention center sold out quickly because of the upcoming global trade summit.
sentences.zh: 因為即將舉辦全球貿易高峰會，會展中心附近的飯店房間很快就賣光了。

words.note: summit 原本是「山頂」，引申為各國領袖或業界大咖聚在一起的「高峰會」，比 forum（論壇）、conference（會議）層級更高。長很像的字：summary（摘要），以及動詞 submit（提交）。

sentences.en: New employees receive a short training session on business etiquette, including how to greet clients properly.
sentences.zh: 新進員工會上一堂簡短的商務禮儀課，包括怎麼正確地問候客戶。

sentences.en: In many Asian countries, it is considered good etiquette to hand business cards over with both hands.
sentences.zh: 在很多亞洲國家，用雙手遞名片被認為是好的禮節。

sentences.en: The hotel staff follow strict telephone etiquette, always answering within three rings and speaking politely.
sentences.zh: 飯店員工遵守嚴格的電話禮儀，一定在響三聲內接起並有禮貌地說話。

sentences.en: Before the overseas trip, Mr. Park read a short guide to local dining etiquette in France and Italy.
sentences.zh: 出國前，朴先生讀了一本關於法國和義大利用餐禮儀的簡短指南。

sentences.en: Good email etiquette means writing a clear subject line and replying to customers within one business day.
sentences.zh: 好的電子郵件禮儀，是寫清楚的主旨，並在一個工作天內回覆客戶。

words.note: etiquette 是社交或工作場合「該有的禮貌規矩」：business etiquette（商務禮儀）、table／dining etiquette（餐桌禮儀）、email etiquette（郵件禮儀）。發音 ET-i-ket，最後的 -quette 唸「ket」。manners 也是禮貌，但比較日常，指一個人的行為舉止。

words.meaning: （便利）設施；生活機能（amenity 的複數）

sentences.en: The hotel offers modern amenities such as a fitness center, an outdoor pool, and free high-speed Wi-Fi.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店提供現代化設施，像是健身中心、戶外泳池和免費高速網路。

sentences.en: The new office building includes amenities like a staff cafeteria, bike parking, and a rooftop garden.
sentences.zh: 新辦公大樓有員工餐廳、腳踏車停車位和屋頂花園等設施。

sentences.en: Apartments in this complex are popular because of their convenient location near the station and excellent shared amenities.
sentences.zh: 這個社區的公寓很搶手，因為離車站近、公共設施又很好。

sentences.en: Guests can find a list of all hotel amenities and their opening hours on the back of the room door.
sentences.zh: 房客可以在房門背面看到飯店所有設施和開放時間的清單。

sentences.en: The city plans to improve public amenities, including parks, libraries, and sports centers, over the next five years.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫在未來五年改善公園、圖書館和運動中心等公共設施。

words.note: amenities 是讓生活或住宿更方便舒適的設施，飯店、租屋、房地產廣告超常見：hotel amenities（飯店設施）、public amenities（公共設施）。通常用複數。和 facilities 很像：facilities 偏「場地、建築設備」，amenities 偏「讓人舒服方便的附加服務」，飯店的盥洗用品也叫 amenities。

sentences.en: Light snacks and cold beverages will be served in the lobby during the afternoon break.
sentences.zh: 下午休息時間，大廳會供應輕食和冷飲。

sentences.en: Guests may not bring outside food or beverages into the concert hall or the theater.
sentences.zh: 賓客不得攜帶外食或飲料進入音樂廳或劇院。

sentences.en: The café sells a wide selection of hot beverages, including coffee, tea, and hot chocolate.
sentences.zh: 這家咖啡店有很多熱飲可以選，包括咖啡、茶和熱可可。

sentences.en: Our company is the largest distributor of soft drinks and other beverages in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 我們公司是東南亞最大的汽水和其他飲料經銷商。

sentences.en: All beverages in the hotel minibar will be charged to your room when you check out.
sentences.zh: 飯店迷你吧的所有飲料，都會在退房時記在你的房帳上。

words.note: beverage 是 drink 比較正式的說法，菜單、公告、飯店、多益常用：food and beverages（餐飲，常縮寫成 F&B）、hot／cold beverages（熱飲／冷飲）、alcoholic beverages（含酒精飲料）。

words.meaning: 進行中的；已經開始的（get underway＝開始）

sentences.en: The annual conference gets underway on Monday morning with a welcome speech by the company president.
sentences.zh: 年度大會週一早上開始，由公司總裁致歡迎詞揭開序幕。

sentences.en: Construction of the new shopping mall is already underway and should be completed by next summer.
sentences.zh: 新購物中心已經在施工了，預計明年夏天前完工。

sentences.en: Plans are underway to open three new branches in southern Taiwan before the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 公司正在規劃年底前在南台灣開三家新分店。

sentences.en: Please turn off your mobile phones before the presentation gets underway in the main hall.
sentences.zh: 主廳的簡報開始前，請把手機關機。

sentences.en: An investigation is underway to find out why the large shipment from Germany arrived two weeks late.
sentences.zh: 目前正在調查，那批從德國來的大批貨物為什麼晚了兩週才到。

words.note: get underway＝開始（get started）；be underway＝正在進行中（in progress）。也可以寫成兩個字 under way。正式公告、新聞很常用：The meeting is now underway.（會議正在進行。）

words.meaning: 親切大方地；有禮地；慷慨地

sentences.en: Mr. Lee graciously agreed to speak at our event even though he had a very busy schedule.
sentences.zh: 李先生雖然行程很滿，還是很親切地答應來我們的活動演講。

sentences.en: The local bakery graciously donated two hundred cakes for the charity fundraising event last weekend.
sentences.zh: 當地麵包店上週末很慷慨地捐了兩百個蛋糕給慈善募款活動。

sentences.en: The hotel manager graciously offered us a free room upgrade after our flight was delayed.
sentences.zh: 我們的班機延誤後，飯店經理很貼心地免費幫我們升等房間。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim graciously accepted the award and warmly thanked everyone who had supported the project from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 金小姐大方得體地接受獎項，並熱情感謝從一開始就支持這個計畫的每個人。

sentences.en: Our sponsor has graciously provided free lunch for all volunteers at this year's beach cleanup.
sentences.zh: 我們的贊助商很慷慨地為今年淨灘的所有志工提供免費午餐。

words.note: graciously 是有禮貌、大方、願意幫忙的樣子，正式感謝或公告很常用：graciously agreed（親切地答應）、graciously donated（慷慨地捐贈）。形容詞 gracious（親切的、得體的）。容易搞混：gracefully（優雅地，指動作）、gratefully（感激地）。

words.meaning: 貢獻者；捐助者；撰稿人；（造成某結果的）因素

sentences.en: Ms. Garcia was the primary contributor to the report, writing most of the chapters on market trends.
sentences.zh: 賈西亞小姐是這份報告的主要貢獻者，市場趨勢的章節大多是她寫的。

sentences.en: The museum thanked every contributor whose generous donation helped pay for the new science exhibition hall.
sentences.zh: 博物館感謝每一位捐助者，他們慷慨的捐款幫忙支付了新科學展覽廳的費用。

sentences.en: Rising fuel prices were the main contributor to the increase in shipping costs this year.
sentences.zh: 燃料價格上漲是今年運費增加的主要原因。

sentences.en: As a regular contributor to the business magazine, Mr. Tan writes about small company management.
sentences.zh: 陳先生是那本商業雜誌的固定撰稿人，專寫小公司的管理。

sentences.en: Our sales team was the biggest contributor to the company's profits during the last quarter.
sentences.zh: 上一季，我們業務團隊是公司獲利的最大功臣。

words.note: contributor 是 contribute（貢獻、捐獻、投稿）的人或東西。primary／main contributor＝主要貢獻者；也可以指「造成某結果的主要因素」。名詞 contribution（貢獻、捐款）。容易搞混：distributor（經銷商）、contractor（承包商）。

sentences.en: The primary goal of this training program is to improve customer service in all of our stores.
sentences.zh: 這個訓練計畫的主要目標，是提升我們所有門市的客戶服務。

sentences.en: Ms. Garcia was the primary contributor to the annual report, so she will present it to the board.
sentences.zh: 賈西亞小姐是年度報告的主要撰寫人，所以由她向董事會報告。

sentences.en: Rising costs are the primary reason why the company decided to close two of its factories.
sentences.zh: 成本上升是公司決定關掉兩間工廠的主要原因。

sentences.en: Please list Mr. Wong as the primary contact person for all questions about the shipment.
sentences.zh: 請把王先生列為這批貨所有問題的主要聯絡人。

sentences.en: Our primary market is young professionals who live and work in large cities across Asia.
sentences.zh: 我們的主要市場是住在亞洲各大城市的年輕上班族。

words.note: primary＝main（主要的），比較正式。常見搭配：primary goal（主要目標）、primary reason（主要原因）、primary contact（主要聯絡人）。也有「初級的」意思：primary school（小學）。副詞 primarily（主要地）。

words.meaning: 攤位；（售票、電話）亭；（餐廳）卡座（booth 的複數）

sentences.en: More than two hundred companies will set up booths at the trade fair to show their latest products.
sentences.zh: 兩百多家公司會在商展設攤，展示他們的最新產品。

sentences.en: Visitors can try free samples at the food booths located near the main entrance of the exhibition hall.
sentences.zh: 參觀者可以在展覽館大門附近的美食攤位試吃。

sentences.en: The event organizer charges five hundred dollars to rent one of the booths for the entire weekend.
sentences.zh: 主辦單位整個週末租一個攤位收五百元。

sentences.en: Our team decorated the company's booths with bright banners to attract more customers at the expo.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊用顯眼的布條裝飾公司的攤位，在博覽會上吸引更多客人。

sentences.en: The ticket booths at the stadium open two hours before the game starts on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 體育場的售票亭在週六比賽開始前兩小時開放。

words.note: booth 是展覽、市集裡的「攤位」（set up a booth＝設攤），也指小亭子：ticket booth（售票亭）、phone booth（電話亭）、photo booth（拍貼機）。餐廳靠牆、有高椅背的「卡座」也叫 booth。stall 也是攤位，比較常指市場、夜市的攤子。

words.meaning: 著名的；重要的；顯眼的；突出的

sentences.en: Several prominent business leaders will speak at the international economic summit in Tokyo next month.
sentences.zh: 下個月在東京的國際經濟高峰會，會有幾位知名企業領袖演講。

sentences.en: The company logo should be displayed in a prominent place on the front of the building.
sentences.zh: 公司標誌應該放在大樓正面顯眼的位置。

sentences.en: Dr. Huang is a prominent scientist who has won many awards for her research on clean energy.
sentences.zh: 黃博士是一位知名科學家，她的潔淨能源研究得過很多獎。

sentences.en: The new product was given a prominent spot near the store entrance so that more customers would notice it.
sentences.zh: 新產品被放在店門口附近的顯眼位置，讓更多客人注意到。

sentences.en: Ms. Ortiz played a prominent role in helping the company expand into the South American market.
sentences.zh: 奧提茲小姐在協助公司拓展南美市場上扮演了重要角色。

words.note: prominent 有兩個意思：①人很有名、重要（a prominent leader）；②東西很顯眼、突出（a prominent place）。常見搭配：play a prominent role（扮演重要角色）。同義詞：famous、well-known、noticeable。和你學過的 notable 很像：notable 強調「值得一提」，prominent 強調「地位高、很顯眼」。

sentences.en: Ms. Chen has agreed to serve as the main contact person for all questions about the trade fair.
sentences.zh: 陳小姐已經答應擔任商展所有問題的主要聯絡人。

sentences.en: The old warehouse will serve as a temporary office while the main building is being renovated.
sentences.zh: 主大樓整修期間，舊倉庫會暫時當作辦公室使用。

sentences.en: Mr. Lopez was asked to serve as the host of the company's annual awards banquet.
sentences.zh: 羅培茲先生受邀擔任公司年度頒獎晚宴的主持人。

sentences.en: These sales figures will serve as a useful guide for setting next year's marketing budget.
sentences.zh: 這些銷售數字會作為訂定明年行銷預算的實用參考。

sentences.en: Volunteers who serve as tour guides must arrive at the museum thirty minutes before opening.
sentences.zh: 擔任導覽員的志工必須在博物館開館前三十分鐘到。

words.note: serve as＋角色或用途＝擔任、當作，人和東西都可以用：serve as chairperson（擔任主席）、This room serves as an office（這間當辦公室用）。和 work as 的差別：work as 通常是職業（work as a nurse），serve as 多是一段時間或特定場合的角色。

words.meaning: （建築物的）側翼；廂房；（鳥、飛機的）翅膀

sentences.en: The conference rooms are located in the east wing of the hotel, next to the main ballroom.
sentences.zh: 會議室在飯店的東側翼，就在大宴會廳旁邊。

sentences.en: The hospital opened a new children's wing last month with fifty beds and a play area.
sentences.zh: 醫院上個月啟用了新的兒童病房大樓，有五十張病床和遊戲區。

sentences.en: Employees in the west wing should use the side exit during the fire drill on Friday.
sentences.zh: 週五消防演習時，西側翼的員工請走側門出口。

sentences.en: The museum's modern art wing will be closed for repairs until the end of March.
sentences.zh: 博物館的現代藝術館區因維修關閉到三月底。

sentences.en: Our accounting department will move to the north wing of the building after the renovation is finished.
sentences.zh: 整修完成後，我們會計部會搬到大樓的北側翼。

words.note: wing 原本是「翅膀」，就像鳥的翅膀從身體往兩邊延伸，大樓從主體延伸出去的一側就叫 wing：east wing（東側翼、東棟）。醫院、飯店、博物館很常用。雞翅也是 chicken wings。

words.meaning: 競爭對手；對手；（形容詞）競爭的

sentences.en: Our main rival lowered its prices last week, so we need to rethink our sales strategy.
sentences.zh: 我們的主要競爭對手上週降價了，所以我們需要重新思考銷售策略。

sentences.en: The new smartphone from our biggest rival has already sold more than one million units in Asia.
sentences.zh: 我們最大競爭對手的新手機，在亞洲已經賣出一百多萬支。

sentences.en: Ms. Kang left her position to join a rival firm that offered her a higher salary.
sentences.zh: 康小姐離職，跳槽到一家給她更高薪水的競爭對手公司。

sentences.en: To stay ahead of every rival in the market, the company invests heavily in research and design.
sentences.zh: 為了在市場上領先所有競爭對手，公司大量投資研發和設計。

sentences.en: The local coffee shop has struggled since a large rival opened a store across the street.
sentences.zh: 自從一家大型競爭對手在對街開店後，這家在地咖啡店就經營得很辛苦。

words.note: rival 和 competitor 意思很像，都是競爭對手。rival 常帶有「實力差不多、彼此較勁」的感覺，也可以放在名詞前面當形容詞：a rival company（對手公司）。長很像的字：arrival（抵達）、revival（復甦）。

sentences.en: The new manager's main goal is to improve the profitability of our stores in southern Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 新經理的主要目標，是提升我們南台灣門市的獲利能力。

sentences.en: Lower shipping costs helped increase the company's profitability by nearly ten percent during the last fiscal year.
sentences.zh: 運費降低，讓公司上個會計年度的獲利提升了將近一成。

sentences.en: Before opening a new branch, the board carefully studied the long-term profitability of the location.
sentences.zh: 開新分店前，董事會仔細研究了那個地點的長期獲利能力。

sentences.en: Many airlines are cutting unprofitable routes in order to return to profitability after a difficult year.
sentences.zh: 經歷艱難的一年後，很多航空公司砍掉賠錢的航線，好讓公司重新獲利。

sentences.en: The consultant suggested reducing waste in the factory as a simple way to boost profitability.
sentences.zh: 顧問建議減少工廠的浪費，這是提升獲利的簡單方法。

words.note: profitability＝profit（利潤）＋able（能夠）＋ity（名詞），也就是「賺錢的能力」。形容詞 profitable（賺錢的、有利潤的），相反詞 unprofitable（賠錢的）。長很像的字：probability（機率）。

words.meaning: 利用；使用（utilize 的 -ing 形）

sentences.en: By utilizing online meeting tools, our team has cut travel costs by more than half this year.
sentences.zh: 今年我們團隊利用線上會議工具，把差旅費砍了一半以上。

sentences.en: The factory is utilizing solar panels on its roof to reduce electricity bills during the summer.
sentences.zh: 工廠利用屋頂上的太陽能板，在夏天減少電費。

sentences.en: We are utilizing customer feedback to improve the design and packaging of our next product line.
sentences.zh: 我們正在利用顧客意見，改善下一系列產品的設計和包裝。

sentences.en: The hotel saves space by utilizing the basement as a storage area for extra furniture.
sentences.zh: 飯店把地下室拿來當多餘家具的倉庫，節省空間。

sentences.en: Utilizing the latest software, the accounting team can now finish monthly reports in just two days.
sentences.zh: 會計團隊利用最新的軟體，現在只要兩天就能完成月報。

words.note: utilize＝use（使用），但更正式，強調「有效地利用、善用」，多益和商業文件很常見。名詞 utilization（利用率）。口語用 use 就好。

words.meaning: 處理；解決（問題）；向……致詞；寫地址

sentences.en: To address this shortcoming, the company will hire two more customer service representatives next month.
sentences.zh: 為了解決這個不足，公司下個月會多請兩位客服人員。

sentences.en: The manager held a meeting to address employees' concerns about the new work schedule and overtime rules.
sentences.zh: 經理開了一場會，處理員工對新班表和加班規定的疑慮。

sentences.en: Our technical team is working hard to address the problems with the online payment system.
sentences.zh: 我們的技術團隊正在努力處理線上付款系統的問題。

sentences.en: The CEO will address all of the shareholders at the annual general meeting on Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 執行長將在週五下午的年度股東大會上向全體股東致詞。

sentences.en: The new policy was created to address complaints about long waiting times at the service counter.
sentences.zh: 這項新政策是為了處理服務櫃檯等候時間太長的抱怨。

words.note: address 當名詞是「地址」，但多益更常考動詞：①處理、解決（address a problem／concern／issue）②向群眾致詞（address the audience）。同義詞：deal with、handle。

sentences.en: To address this shortcoming, the company will offer extra training to all new sales staff.
sentences.zh: 為了改善這個不足，公司會給所有新進業務人員額外的訓練。

sentences.en: The main shortcoming of the new software is that it does not work well on older computers.
sentences.zh: 新軟體的主要缺點是在舊電腦上跑不太順。

sentences.en: The report pointed out one serious shortcoming in our delivery system: orders often arrive late.
sentences.zh: 報告指出我們配送系統的一個嚴重問題：訂單常常晚到。

sentences.en: Every product has at least one shortcoming, so we should listen carefully to customer feedback.
sentences.zh: 每個產品至少都有一個缺點，所以我們應該仔細聽顧客的意見。

sentences.en: Ms. Wu admitted that her biggest shortcoming as a manager was not delegating enough work.
sentences.zh: 吳小姐承認，她當主管最大的缺點是不太會把工作分派出去。

words.note: shortcoming＝缺點、不足，比 weakness 正式一點，常用在產品、計畫、系統或人的能力。同義詞：weakness、flaw、drawback。注意 shortage 是「短缺、不夠用」（例如缺貨、缺人），不是缺點。

words.meaning: （活動、會議、比賽的）場地；舉辦地點

sentences.en: The hotel's grand ballroom has been chosen as the venue for this year's awards banquet.
sentences.zh: 飯店的大宴會廳被選為今年頒獎晚宴的場地。

sentences.en: We need to find a larger venue because more than five hundred people have registered for the seminar.
sentences.zh: 有五百多人報名研討會，所以我們需要找更大的場地。

sentences.en: Please arrive at the venue at least thirty minutes early to set up your company's booth.
sentences.zh: 請至少提早三十分鐘到場地，布置貴公司的攤位。

sentences.en: The concert venue is easy to reach by subway and has a large parking lot nearby.
sentences.zh: 演唱會場地搭捷運很方便，附近還有大型停車場。

sentences.en: Due to the typhoon warning, the outdoor wedding was moved to an indoor venue near the beach.
sentences.zh: 因為颱風警報，戶外婚禮改到海邊附近的室內場地舉行。

words.note: venue 是「舉辦活動的地點」，會議、演唱會、婚禮、比賽都可以用：wedding venue（婚禮場地）、concert venue（演唱會場地）。和 location 的差別：location 是一般的「位置」，venue 一定跟活動有關。長很像的字：avenue（大道）、revenue（營收）。

words.meaning: 餐巾；餐巾紙（napkin 的複數）

sentences.en: The waiter brought us extra napkins after the children spilled their juice on the table.
sentences.zh: 小孩把果汁打翻在桌上後，服務生多拿了一些餐巾紙給我們。

sentences.en: Our café switched to recycled paper napkins last month to reduce waste and lower its costs.
sentences.zh: 我們咖啡店上個月改用回收紙做的餐巾紙，減少浪費也降低成本。

sentences.en: For the banquet, the cloth napkins should be folded neatly and placed on top of each plate.
sentences.zh: 晚宴的布餐巾要摺整齊，放在每個盤子上面。

sentences.en: Please restock the napkins and plastic forks at the self-service counter before the lunch rush begins.
sentences.zh: 午餐尖峰時段開始前，請把自助區的餐巾紙和塑膠叉子補滿。

sentences.en: Customers can find straws, napkins, and sugar packets on the small table next to the cashier.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在收銀台旁邊的小桌子上拿吸管、餐巾紙和糖包。

words.note: napkin 是吃飯時擦嘴、擦手用的餐巾，可以是紙的（paper napkin）或布的（cloth napkin）。英式也常說 serviette。tissue 是一般的「面紙、衛生紙」，不是餐桌專用。

sentences.en: The company placed a full-page advertisement in the newspaper to promote its big year-end sale this December.
sentences.zh: 公司在報紙上刊登全版廣告，宣傳今年十二月的年終大特賣。

sentences.en: According to the advertisement, the hotel offers free breakfast and airport pickup for all guests.
sentences.zh: 根據廣告，這間飯店為所有房客提供免費早餐和機場接送。

sentences.en: We received over one hundred applications after posting a job advertisement on our website last week.
sentences.zh: 上週我們在網站上刊登徵才廣告後，收到一百多份應徵資料。

sentences.en: The new television advertisement for our sports drink will be shown during the baseball games.
sentences.zh: 我們運動飲料的新電視廣告會在棒球比賽時播出。

sentences.en: Please check the price in the advertisement carefully, because some items are on sale only this weekend.
sentences.zh: 請仔細看廣告上的價格，因為有些商品只有這個週末特價。

words.note: advertisement 的拼法：advertise（打廣告，動詞）＋ment。口語常縮寫成 ad 或 advert（英式）。相關字：advertising（廣告業；廣告活動）、advertiser（廣告主）。多益常見：job advertisement（徵才廣告）、place an advertisement（刊登廣告）。

sentences.en: Our furniture store is offering thirty percent off all mattresses and bed frames this weekend only.
sentences.zh: 我們家具店只有這個週末，所有床墊和床架都打七折。

sentences.en: The hotel replaced the old mattresses in every guest room last month to improve customer comfort and reviews.
sentences.zh: 飯店上個月把每間客房的舊床墊都換掉，提升房客的舒適度和評價。

sentences.en: Customers can try our mattresses in the showroom for as long as they like before buying.
sentences.zh: 顧客購買前可以在展示間盡情試躺我們的床墊。

sentences.en: The delivery fee for large items such as mattresses and sofas is included in the price.
sentences.zh: 床墊和沙發這類大型商品的運費已經包含在價格裡。

sentences.en: All of our mattresses come with a ten-year warranty and free removal of your old bed.
sentences.zh: 我們所有床墊都有十年保固，還免費幫你回收舊床。

words.note: mattress 是床上那塊「床墊」，複數加 -es：mattresses。相關字：bed frame（床架）、pillow（枕頭）、sheet（床單）、comforter／duvet（棉被）。拼法注意兩個 t、兩個 s：ma-tt-re-ss。

sentences.en: Our new mattresses are made with three layers of memory foam for extra comfort and support.
sentences.zh: 我們的新床墊用了三層記憶泡棉，更舒適、支撐力更好。

sentences.en: Fragile items such as glass vases should be packed in soft foam before they are shipped.
sentences.zh: 玻璃花瓶這類易碎品，寄出前要用軟泡棉包好。

sentences.en: The café adds a thick layer of milk foam on top of every cappuccino it serves.
sentences.zh: 這家咖啡店每杯卡布奇諾上面都會加一層厚厚的奶泡。

sentences.en: The office chairs have cushions filled with high-quality foam that does not lose its shape.
sentences.zh: 辦公椅的坐墊裡填了高品質泡棉，不容易變形。

sentences.en: Firefighters used special foam to put out the fire in the chemical warehouse last night.
sentences.zh: 消防員昨晚用特殊泡沫撲滅了化學品倉庫的火。

words.note: foam 可以是液體上的「泡沫」（milk foam 奶泡、shaving foam 刮鬍泡），也可以是軟軟的「泡棉」材質（memory foam 記憶泡棉，床墊、枕頭常見）。和 bubble 的差別：bubble 是一顆一顆的泡泡，foam 是一大片細小泡泡。

sentences.en: The cake has three layers of chocolate and is decorated with fresh strawberries on top.
sentences.zh: 這個蛋糕有三層巧克力，上面用新鮮草莓裝飾。

sentences.en: Visitors to the mountain should wear several layers of clothing because the weather changes quickly.
sentences.zh: 上山的遊客應該穿好幾層衣服，因為天氣變化很快。

sentences.en: Each package is protected by two layers of bubble wrap to prevent damage during delivery.
sentences.zh: 每個包裹都用兩層氣泡紙保護，避免運送中損壞。

sentences.en: The new window design uses three layers of glass to keep the office quiet and warm.
sentences.zh: 新的窗戶設計用了三層玻璃，讓辦公室安靜又保暖。

sentences.en: Our management structure has only two layers, so important decisions can be made much more quickly.
sentences.zh: 我們的管理架構只有兩層，所以重要決定可以快很多。

words.note: layer＝一層：a layer of dust（一層灰）、layers of clothing（多層衣服，洋蔥式穿法）。也可以當動詞「一層一層疊」：layer the vegetables。抽象用法：layers of management（管理層級）。

words.meaning: 建立；成立；確立（地位）（establish 的過去式／過去分詞）

sentences.en: Within ten years, the company has established itself as one of the country's top furniture manufacturers.
sentences.zh: 短短十年內，這家公司已經成為國內頂尖的家具製造商之一。

sentences.en: The hotel was established in 1925 and is still run by the same family today.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店創立於 1925 年，到今天仍由同一個家族經營。

sentences.en: Ms. Park quickly established a good relationship with several of our biggest clients in Japan and Korea.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐很快就和我們在日本、韓國的幾位大客戶建立了良好關係。

sentences.en: The firm has established offices in five Asian cities to support its growing number of customers.
sentences.zh: 這家公司在五個亞洲城市設立了辦公室，服務越來越多的客戶。

sentences.en: Clear safety rules were established for all workers after the accident at the factory last spring.
sentences.zh: 去年春天工廠發生意外後，為所有工人訂立了清楚的安全規定。

words.note: establish＝建立、成立（公司、關係、規則）。establish oneself as＝讓自己成為、確立地位（has established itself as a top brand）。名詞 establishment（建立；機構、店家）。也常當形容詞：an established company（老字號、有規模的公司）。

words.meaning: 隨身物品；個人財物；行李

sentences.en: Passengers are reminded to take all their personal belongings with them when leaving the train.
sentences.zh: 提醒乘客下車時帶走所有隨身物品。

sentences.en: Please do not leave your belongings unattended in the hotel lobby or the waiting area.
sentences.zh: 請不要把隨身物品放在飯店大廳或等候區無人看管。

sentences.en: The company is not responsible for any lost belongings left in the meeting rooms after the event.
sentences.zh: 活動結束後留在會議室的遺失物品，公司恕不負責。

sentences.en: Employees can store their belongings in the free lockers located next to the staff entrance on the first floor.
sentences.zh: 員工可以把個人物品放在一樓員工入口旁的免費置物櫃。

sentences.en: After the move, it took Mr. Chen two weeks to unpack all of his belongings at the new apartment.
sentences.zh: 搬家後，陳先生花了兩個禮拜才把新公寓裡所有的東西拆箱整理好。

words.note: belongings 永遠用複數，指「屬於你的東西」：personal belongings（隨身物品）。來自動詞 belong to（屬於）。車站、飛機、飯店廣播超常見：Please take all your belongings with you.（請帶走您的隨身物品）。相近：possessions（財產，比較正式）、stuff（東西，口語）。

words.meaning: 強制的；義務的；一定要做的

sentences.en: Attendance at the safety training session is mandatory for all new factory employees starting next Monday.
sentences.zh: 從下週一開始，所有工廠新進員工都必須參加安全訓練課。

sentences.en: Wearing a helmet is mandatory in the construction area at all times, even for short visits.
sentences.zh: 在工地區域隨時都必須戴安全帽，就算只是短暫參觀也一樣。

sentences.en: The company introduced a mandatory retirement age of sixty-five for all of its full-time staff members.
sentences.zh: 公司為所有全職員工訂了六十五歲強制退休的規定。

sentences.en: Please note that it is mandatory to show a valid ID when picking up your package.
sentences.zh: 請注意，領取包裹時一定要出示有效證件。

sentences.en: All drivers must complete a mandatory rest period of thirty minutes after every four hours of driving.
sentences.zh: 所有司機每開四小時，都必須強制休息三十分鐘。

words.note: mandatory＝規定一定要做的，同義詞 compulsory、required、obligatory。相反詞：optional（可選擇的）、voluntary（自願的）。多益常見：mandatory training（強制訓練）、attendance is mandatory（一定要出席）。

words.meaning: 校對；校稿（檢查錯字和文法）

sentences.en: Please proofread the brochure carefully before we send it to the printing company on Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 週五早上送印刷廠之前，請仔細校對這份宣傳手冊。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin asked her assistant to proofread the sales contract for any spelling and grammar mistakes.
sentences.zh: 林小姐請助理校對銷售合約，檢查有沒有拼字和文法錯誤。

sentences.en: All articles must be proofread by at least two editors before they are published online.
sentences.zh: 所有文章上網發布前，都必須經過至少兩位編輯校對。

sentences.en: It is a good idea to proofread your résumé several times before applying for a job.
sentences.zh: 應徵工作前，最好把履歷多校對幾次。

sentences.en: The marketing team hired a freelancer to proofread the English version of the company website.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊請了一位自由工作者校對公司網站的英文版。

words.note: proofread＝proof（校樣、印刷前的樣稿）＋read（讀），也就是「印刷或發布前，仔細看一遍挑錯」。三態都一樣：proofread–proofread–proofread（後兩個唸 red）。做校對的人叫 proofreader。相近：edit（編輯，會改內容），proofread 只挑錯字、文法、格式。

sentences.en: The opening ceremony for the new factory will take place next Monday at ten o'clock in the morning.
sentences.zh: 新工廠的開幕典禮將在下週一早上十點舉行。

sentences.en: More than five hundred guests attended the awards ceremony held at the city's largest hotel.
sentences.zh: 五百多位賓客出席了在市內最大飯店舉辦的頒獎典禮。

sentences.en: The mayor cut a red ribbon during a short ceremony to mark the opening of the new library.
sentences.zh: 市長在簡短的典禮上剪綵，慶祝新圖書館開幕。

sentences.en: All graduates must arrive at the hall one hour before the ceremony begins to receive their gowns.
sentences.zh: 所有畢業生必須在典禮開始前一小時到禮堂領取學士服。

sentences.en: The company held a small ceremony to thank employees who had worked there for more than twenty years.
sentences.zh: 公司舉辦了一場小型儀式，感謝服務超過二十年的員工。

words.note: ceremony 是正式的典禮或儀式：opening ceremony（開幕典禮）、awards ceremony（頒獎典禮）、wedding ceremony（婚禮儀式）、graduation ceremony（畢業典禮）。和 banquet（宴會，重點在吃飯）、reception（招待會，比較輕鬆）不同，ceremony 重點在「正式的流程」。

words.meaning: 優勢；好處；優點（take advantage of＝利用、把握）

sentences.en: Customers are encouraged to take advantage of our free one-week trial before buying a full membership.
sentences.zh: 我們鼓勵顧客在購買正式會員前，先好好利用一週免費試用。

sentences.en: The biggest advantage of the new office is its location just two minutes from the subway station.
sentences.zh: 新辦公室最大的優點，是離捷運站只要兩分鐘。

sentences.en: Employees should take advantage of the free training courses offered by the human resources department.
sentences.zh: 員工應該好好利用人資部門提供的免費訓練課程。

sentences.en: Our long experience in the Asian market gives us a clear advantage over newer competitors.
sentences.zh: 我們在亞洲市場的長期經驗，讓我們比新的競爭對手更有優勢。

sentences.en: Many shoppers took advantage of the year-end holiday sale to buy laptops and phones at half price.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客趁著年底假期特賣，用半價買了筆電和手機。

words.note: take advantage of＝好好利用、把握（機會、優惠）。也可能有負面意思：take advantage of someone＝占某人便宜。相反詞 disadvantage（缺點、劣勢）。have an advantage over…＝比……有優勢。

sentences.en: All hotel guests receive a complimentary breakfast and free access to the fitness center during their stay.
sentences.zh: 所有房客住宿期間都享有免費早餐，並可免費使用健身中心。

sentences.en: Each attendee at the conference will be given a complimentary tote bag with the company logo on it.
sentences.zh: 每位與會者都會拿到一個印有公司標誌的免費托特包。

sentences.en: The restaurant offered us complimentary desserts because our main dishes took over an hour to arrive.
sentences.zh: 因為主菜等了一個多小時才上，餐廳招待我們免費甜點。

sentences.en: Customers who spend more than two thousand dollars will receive a complimentary gift wrapping service.
sentences.zh: 消費超過兩千元的顧客，可以享有免費禮品包裝服務。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee received many complimentary comments from clients about her clear, friendly, and well-organized sales presentation last week.
sentences.zh: 李小姐上週清楚、親切又有條理的業務簡報，得到很多客戶的稱讚。

words.note: complimentary 在多益最常見的意思是「免費贈送的」（飯店、餐廳、活動），比 free 更正式、更有禮貌。來自 compliment（讚美），所以也有「讚美的」意思。⚠️ 拼法很像的 complementary（中間是 e）是「互補的」，常被拼錯，考試很愛考。

words.meaning: 公頃（hectare 的複數，面積單位）

sentences.en: The company plans to build a new factory on fifty hectares of land near the port.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫在港口附近五十公頃的土地上蓋新工廠。

sentences.en: The national park covers more than three thousand hectares of thick forest, quiet lakes, and high mountains.
sentences.zh: 國家公園占地三千多公頃，有茂密的森林、寧靜的湖泊和高山。

sentences.en: The farm grows organic vegetables on twelve hectares and sells them directly to local restaurants.
sentences.zh: 這座農場在十二公頃的土地上種有機蔬菜，直接賣給當地餐廳。

sentences.en: About two hundred hectares of farmland were damaged by the heavy rain and flooding in the south last month.
sentences.zh: 上個月南部的豪雨和淹水，讓大約兩百公頃的農地受損。

sentences.en: The new business park will cover eighty hectares and include offices, shops, and a hotel.
sentences.zh: 新的商業園區占地八十公頃，會有辦公室、商店和一間飯店。

words.note: 1 hectare（公頃）＝10,000 平方公尺，大約 3,025 坪，差不多一個半足球場大。常和 of land／farmland 一起出現。另一個常見面積單位是 acre（英畝），1 公頃約 2.5 英畝。

words.meaning: 問卷；調查表（questionnaire 的複數）

sentences.en: All participants were asked to fill out short questionnaires about their experience at the training workshop.
sentences.zh: 所有參加者都被請求填寫簡短的問卷，分享參加訓練工作坊的心得。

sentences.en: The marketing team sent online questionnaires to five hundred customers to learn more about their shopping habits.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊寄了線上問卷給五百位顧客，想更了解他們的購物習慣。

sentences.en: Please return the completed questionnaires to the front desk before you check out of the hotel tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天退房前，請把填好的問卷交回櫃檯。

sentences.en: According to the questionnaires, most employees would prefer to start work earlier and finish at five.
sentences.zh: 根據問卷結果，大部分員工比較想早點上班、五點下班。

sentences.en: The research company will analyze the questionnaires and present the results at next month's meeting.
sentences.zh: 研究公司會分析這些問卷，並在下個月的會議上報告結果。

words.note: questionnaire＝question（問題）＋naire，就是一張列滿問題的「問卷」。拼法注意：兩個 n（questio-nn-aire），結尾是 -aire。常見搭配：fill out／complete a questionnaire（填問卷）。同義詞 survey（調查），survey 比較常指整個調查活動。

sentences.en: The initial cost of the new software is high, but it will save us money over time.
sentences.zh: 新軟體一開始的費用很高，但長期下來會幫我們省錢。

sentences.en: Our initial plan was to open the store in May, but construction delays pushed it to July.
sentences.zh: 我們原本計畫五月開店，但工程延誤，延到了七月。

sentences.en: After an initial interview by phone, the top candidates will be invited to meet the manager in person.
sentences.zh: 經過第一輪電話面試後，表現最好的應徵者會受邀和經理當面見面。

sentences.en: The initial results of the customer survey show that most people are happy with our service.
sentences.zh: 顧客調查的初步結果顯示，大部分人對我們的服務很滿意。

sentences.en: The initial response to our new advertising campaign has been very positive, especially among young customers.
sentences.zh: 我們新廣告活動一開始的反應非常好，尤其是年輕顧客。

words.note: initial＝first（最初的），比較正式：initial cost（初期費用）、initial plan（原本的計畫）、initial interview（初次面試）。副詞 initially（起初）。名詞 initials 是「姓名縮寫」，例如陳世鈞的英文縮寫 SC。

words.meaning: 報告人；講者；（節目）主持人

sentences.en: Each presenter will have fifteen minutes to explain their project, followed by five minutes for questions.
sentences.zh: 每位報告人有十五分鐘說明自己的專案，接著有五分鐘問答時間。

sentences.en: The presenter used clear charts and simple examples to explain the company's new sales strategy.
sentences.zh: 講者用清楚的圖表和簡單的例子，說明公司新的業務策略。

sentences.en: Please send your slides to the event organizer if you have been chosen as a presenter at the conference.
sentences.zh: 如果你被選為研討會的講者，請把投影片寄給活動主辦人。

sentences.en: The television presenter interviewed three local business owners about the effects of rising rent and food prices.
sentences.zh: 電視節目主持人訪問了三位在地店家老闆，談房租和食物漲價的影響。

sentences.en: Our first presenter this morning is Ms. Kato, who will talk about online marketing trends in Asia.
sentences.zh: 今天早上第一位講者是加藤小姐，她會談亞洲的網路行銷趨勢。

words.note: presenter＝present（報告、介紹）＋er，就是「上台報告或主持的人」。名詞 presentation（簡報、報告）。相近：speaker（演講者）、host（主持人、主辦人）。英式英文的電視節目主持人常說 presenter，美式多說 host。

sentences.en: The city plans to build a new recreational facility with a swimming pool and tennis courts.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫蓋一座新的休閒設施，有游泳池和網球場。

sentences.en: The hotel offers many recreational activities, including morning yoga classes, guided bike tours, and cooking lessons.
sentences.zh: 飯店提供很多休閒活動，包括晨間瑜伽、單車導覽和烹飪課。

sentences.en: Employees can use the company's recreational area to relax and play table tennis during their lunch break.
sentences.zh: 員工午休時可以到公司的休閒區放鬆、打桌球。

sentences.en: The park will be closed for recreational use while workers repair the walking paths and benches.
sentences.zh: 工人修理步道和長椅期間，公園將暫停開放休閒使用。

sentences.en: Our apartment complex provides a recreational room where residents can watch movies and play games.
sentences.zh: 我們的社區有一間休閒室，住戶可以在那裡看電影、玩遊戲。

words.note: recreational 來自 recreation（休閒、娛樂），指工作以外放鬆、運動、玩樂的：recreational facility（休閒設施）、recreational activities（休閒活動）。re＋create＝讓自己「重新充電」。

words.meaning: （節日、紀念日的）慶祝、紀念；（規定的）遵守

sentences.en: In observance of the national holiday, all branch offices will be closed on Monday, October 10.
sentences.zh: 為了慶祝國定假日，所有分公司在十月十日星期一休息。

sentences.en: The bank will not process any payments on Friday in observance of the Lunar New Year.
sentences.zh: 因為農曆新年，銀行週五不處理任何付款。

sentences.en: Strict observance of the safety rules has helped the factory avoid accidents for three years.
sentences.zh: 嚴格遵守安全規定，讓工廠三年來都沒發生意外。

sentences.en: The museum will offer free admission on Saturday in observance of the city's two hundredth anniversary.
sentences.zh: 為了紀念建城兩百週年，博物館週六免費入場。

sentences.en: Please note that our customer service center will close early today in observance of Memorial Day.
sentences.zh: 請注意，因為陣亡將士紀念日，我們的客服中心今天會提早關閉。

words.note: in observance of＋節日＝為了慶祝／紀念某個節日（公告最常見：…will be closed in observance of the holiday）。也有「遵守」的意思：observance of the rules。來自動詞 observe（遵守；慶祝）。⚠️ 長很像的 observation 是「觀察」。

sentences.en: The airline's inaugural flight from Taipei to Seattle will depart from Taoyuan Airport next Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 這家航空公司台北飛西雅圖的首航班機，下週二早上從桃園機場出發。

sentences.en: More than two thousand people attended the inaugural meeting of the new business association last weekend.
sentences.zh: 上週末新的商業協會第一次大會，有兩千多人參加。

sentences.en: The president gave his inaugural speech in front of thousands of supporters in the city square.
sentences.zh: 總統在市中心廣場數千名支持者面前發表就職演說。

sentences.en: The inaugural issue of our company magazine will be sent to all employees and clients next week.
sentences.zh: 我們公司雜誌的創刊號下週會寄給所有員工和客戶。

sentences.en: Our team won the inaugural award for customer service excellence at this year's industry conference.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊在今年的產業大會上，拿下第一屆優良客服獎。

words.note: inaugural＝第一次的、開幕的、就職的，比 first 正式很多：inaugural flight（首航）、inaugural issue（創刊號）、inaugural speech（就職演說）。動詞 inaugurate（為……舉行就職或開幕典禮），名詞 inauguration（就職典禮）。發音：ih-NAW-gyuh-rul。

words.meaning: 紀念；慶祝（重要的日子或事件）

sentences.en: The company will hold a special dinner to commemorate its fiftieth anniversary at the Grand Hotel next month.
sentences.zh: 公司下個月會舉辦一場特別晚宴，在君悅飯店紀念創立五十週年。

sentences.en: A bronze statue was built in the central park to commemorate the man who founded the city in 1850.
sentences.zh: 中央公園立了一座銅像，紀念 1850 年建立這座城市的人。

sentences.en: The post office issued a set of new stamps to commemorate the opening of the national high-speed railway.
sentences.zh: 郵局發行了一套新郵票，紀念全國高鐵通車。

sentences.en: To commemorate Foundation Day, employees will receive a small gift and a free lunch in the cafeteria.
sentences.zh: 為了紀念公司創立日，員工會收到小禮物，還能在員工餐廳免費吃午餐。

sentences.en: Our team designed a special logo to commemorate the opening of our one hundredth store in Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊設計了特別的標誌，紀念在台灣開第一百家店。

words.note: commemorate＝用活動、典禮、紀念品來「紀念」重要的人或事，比 celebrate（慶祝）更正式、更有紀念意義。名詞 commemoration（紀念），形容詞 commemorative（紀念的，例如 commemorative stamps 紀念郵票）。和你學過的 in observance of 很像。

words.meaning: 基礎；地基；基金會；創立（Foundation Day＝創立紀念日）

sentences.en: The company celebrates Foundation Day every March to remember the day it was first established.
sentences.zh: 公司每年三月慶祝創立紀念日，紀念當初成立的那一天。

sentences.en: A strong foundation in basic math will help new accounting employees understand our monthly financial reports.
sentences.zh: 扎實的基礎數學能力，能幫助新的會計人員看懂我們的月財報。

sentences.en: The children's charity foundation donated over one million dollars last year to build schools in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 這個兒童慈善基金會去年捐了一百多萬元，在偏鄉蓋學校。

sentences.en: Engineers found several small cracks in the old building's foundation during the safety inspection last week.
sentences.zh: 工程師上週安全檢查時，在舊大樓的地基發現幾道小裂縫。

sentences.en: Good communication is the foundation of a successful long-term relationship with our clients and suppliers.
sentences.zh: 良好的溝通是和客戶、供應商建立長期合作關係的基礎。

words.note: foundation 意思很多：①基礎（a strong foundation）②建築的地基 ③基金會（charity foundation）④創立（Foundation Day＝公司或學校的創立紀念日，也叫 Founders' Day）。來自 found（創立）。化妝品的「粉底」也叫 foundation。

words.meaning: 替代的；備用的；交替的（每隔一個）

sentences.en: Due to road construction, drivers are advised to take an alternate route to the airport this week.
sentences.zh: 因為道路施工，這週建議駕駛改走替代道路去機場。

sentences.en: If you cannot attend the meeting on Monday, please let us know so we can choose an alternate date.
sentences.zh: 如果你週一不能參加會議，請告訴我們，我們好另外選一天。

sentences.en: The team meets in person on alternate Fridays and holds online meetings during the other weeks.
sentences.zh: 團隊每隔一個星期五見面開會，其他週則線上開會。

sentences.en: Each speaker should prepare an alternate topic in case another presenter talks about the same subject.
sentences.zh: 每位講者都要準備一個備用主題，以免和其他講者講到一樣的內容。

sentences.en: The flight was canceled, so the airline booked all passengers on an alternate flight leaving two hours later.
sentences.zh: 班機取消了，航空公司幫所有乘客改訂兩小時後起飛的替代班機。

words.note: alternate 有兩個意思：①替代的、備用的（alternate route 替代道路），和 alternative 意思很像，美式常混用；②交替的、每隔一個（on alternate days＝每隔一天）。也可以當動詞「輪流、交替」：alternate between A and B。

words.meaning: 加總；把……加起來；（金額）累積起來

sentences.en: Please add up all the travel expenses on this list and send the total to the accounting team.
sentences.zh: 請把這張清單上所有的差旅費加總，再把總額寄給會計部。

sentences.en: The cashier forgot to add up the prices correctly, so the customer was charged too much.
sentences.zh: 收銀員沒把價格正確加總，所以顧客被多收了錢。

sentences.en: Small daily costs like coffee and taxis can quickly add up to a large amount each month.
sentences.zh: 像咖啡、計程車這種每天的小花費，每個月很快就會累積成一大筆錢。

sentences.en: At the end of each week, the store manager has to add up the sales from all three cash registers.
sentences.zh: 每週結束時，店長要把三台收銀機的營業額加總起來。

sentences.en: Before submitting the budget, could you add up the numbers again to make sure there are no mistakes?
sentences.zh: 交出預算前，你可以再把數字加一次，確定沒有錯嗎？

words.note: add up＝把數字加起來（add up the bill）。add up to＝總共是……：The costs add up to $500（費用總共 500 元）。口語 It doesn't add up 是「說不通、不合理」。相近：total（總計）、sum up（總結、合計）。

words.meaning: 標誌著；代表（某件事的開始、結束或重要時刻）；紀念

sentences.en: Today's workshop marks the first of five training sessions that will take place over the next two weeks.
sentences.zh: 今天的工作坊是接下來兩週五堂訓練課的第一堂。

sentences.en: The opening of our Tokyo branch marks the beginning of the company's expansion into Japan.
sentences.zh: 東京分公司開幕，代表公司正式開始進軍日本。

sentences.en: This year marks the twentieth anniversary of our successful partnership with the local technical university.
sentences.zh: 今年是我們和當地科技大學成功合作的二十週年。

sentences.en: The new product launch marks an important step in our plan to reach younger customers.
sentences.zh: 新產品上市是我們爭取年輕客群計畫中重要的一步。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin's promotion to director marks the end of her long career in the sales department.
sentences.zh: 林小姐升任總監，也代表她在業務部的漫長生涯畫下句點。

words.note: 語塊：mark the beginning／end of（標誌著……的開始／結束）、mark the first of（是……的第一個）、mark the anniversary（是……週年）。mark 當動詞是「標誌、代表某個重要時刻」，不是「做記號」而已。也常用 to mark the occasion（為了紀念這個時刻）。

sentences.en: The restaurant is renowned for its fresh seafood and has won several international cooking awards since it opened.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳以新鮮海鮮聞名，開業以來拿過好幾個國際料理獎。

sentences.en: Our keynote speaker is a world-renowned expert in artificial intelligence who has written three best-selling books.
sentences.zh: 我們的主講人是世界知名的人工智慧專家，寫過三本暢銷書。

sentences.en: The new five-star hotel downtown was designed by an internationally renowned architect from Milan, Italy.
sentences.zh: 市中心這間新的五星級飯店，是由一位來自義大利米蘭的國際知名建築師設計的。

sentences.en: Taiwan is renowned for its night markets, which attract millions of visitors from around the world every year.
sentences.zh: 台灣以夜市聞名，每年吸引數百萬來自世界各地的遊客。

sentences.en: The company hired a renowned chef to create a special menu for its anniversary banquet.
sentences.zh: 公司請了一位知名主廚，為週年晚宴設計特別菜單。

words.note: 語塊：be renowned for（以……聞名）、world-renowned（世界知名的）、internationally renowned（國際知名的）。同義詞 famous、well-known，renowned 比較正式、帶有「因為很優秀而有名」的感覺。和你學過的 prominent（地位高、顯眼）、notable（值得一提）很像。

words.meaning: 插座；門市、銷售點；（媒體）管道（outlet 的複數）

sentences.en: Each meeting room has several power outlets, so attendees can charge their laptops during the session.
sentences.zh: 每間會議室都有好幾個插座，與會者開會時可以幫筆電充電。

sentences.en: The company plans to open fifty new retail outlets across Southeast Asia over the next three years.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫在未來三年內，在東南亞開五十家新的零售門市。

sentences.en: Several major news outlets reported on the merger between the two airlines before it was officially announced.
sentences.zh: 在正式宣布前，好幾家主要新聞媒體就已經報導了兩家航空公司合併的消息。

sentences.en: Our products are now sold through more than two hundred outlets, including supermarkets and convenience stores.
sentences.zh: 我們的產品現在在兩百多個銷售點販售，包括超市和便利商店。

sentences.en: Please do not plug heaters into the outlets near the sink, as this can be dangerous.
sentences.zh: 請不要把暖氣機插在水槽附近的插座，這樣很危險。

words.note: 語塊：power outlet（電源插座）、retail outlet（零售門市）、news／media outlet（新聞媒體）。outlet 原本是「出口」，所以電流的出口＝插座、商品的出口＝銷售點、新聞的出口＝媒體。outlet mall／outlet store 是「暢貨中心、過季折扣店」。

words.meaning: 閒話少說；不多說了；那麼就直接開始

sentences.en: Without further ado, please welcome our keynote speaker for this year's conference, Ms. Lisa Chen.
sentences.zh: 閒話不多說，讓我們歡迎今年研討會的主講人，陳麗莎小姐。

sentences.en: We have a lot to cover today, so without further ado, let's begin the first presentation.
sentences.zh: 今天要講的內容很多，所以不多說了，我們開始第一場簡報。

sentences.en: The host thanked the sponsors and then, without further ado, announced the winner of the sales award.
sentences.zh: 主持人感謝贊助商之後，就直接宣布了業績獎得主。

sentences.en: Since everyone has arrived, I would like to start the monthly sales meeting without further ado.
sentences.zh: 既然大家都到了，我們就直接開始每月業務會議吧。

sentences.en: Without further ado, let me introduce the newest member of our marketing team, Mr. David Wu.
sentences.zh: 話不多說，讓我介紹行銷團隊的新成員，吳大衛先生。

words.note: 語塊：without further ado, let's begin／please welcome…（不多說了，我們開始吧／讓我們歡迎……）。主持人、簡報開場最常用的一句話。ado 是古老的字，意思是「麻煩、囉嗦」，現在幾乎只出現在這個片語裡。發音 uh-DOO。

sentences.en: Ms. Huang studied at a famous culinary school in Paris before opening her own restaurant in Taipei.
sentences.zh: 黃小姐在台北開自己的餐廳前，曾在巴黎一所知名廚藝學校念書。

sentences.en: Applicants for the chef position must have strong culinary skills and at least three years of experience.
sentences.zh: 應徵主廚職位的人必須有很好的廚藝，並有至少三年經驗。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a culinary tour that lets guests taste traditional dishes at local night markets.
sentences.zh: 飯店提供美食導覽行程，讓房客在當地夜市品嚐傳統小吃。

sentences.en: Our new cooking show will introduce viewers to the rich culinary traditions of different regions across Asia.
sentences.zh: 我們的新料理節目會帶觀眾認識亞洲各地豐富的飲食傳統。

sentences.en: The city is hosting an international culinary festival featuring more than one hundred chefs from twenty countries.
sentences.zh: 市政府正在舉辦國際美食節，有來自二十個國家、一百多位主廚參加。

words.note: 語塊：culinary skills（廚藝）、culinary school（廚藝學校）、culinary arts（烹飪藝術）、culinary tour（美食之旅）。culinary 比 cooking 正式，常出現在餐廳、飯店、觀光的介紹裡。發音 KUL-ih-nair-ee 或 KYOO-lih-nair-ee。

words.meaning: 分發；分配；（商品）經銷、配送

sentences.en: Please distribute the handouts to all participants before the morning training session begins at nine o'clock.
sentences.zh: 早上九點訓練課開始前，請把講義發給所有學員。

sentences.en: The company will distribute its new energy drink to convenience stores across the country next month.
sentences.zh: 公司下個月會把新的能量飲料配送到全國的便利商店。

sentences.en: Volunteers helped distribute free meals and bottled water among the families affected by last week's flooding.
sentences.zh: 志工幫忙把免費餐點和瓶裝水分送給上週水災受災的家庭。

sentences.en: Our firm is looking for a reliable partner to distribute our products in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 我們公司正在找可靠的夥伴，在東南亞經銷我們的產品。

sentences.en: The manager decided to distribute the extra work equally among all members of the sales team.
sentences.zh: 經理決定把多出來的工作平均分配給業務團隊的每個人。

words.note: 語塊：distribute A to B（把 A 分發給 B）、distribute A among…（把 A 分給一群人）、distribute products（經銷產品）。dis（分開）＋tribute（給）＝分開給大家。名詞 distribution（分配；配送），經銷商是 distributor。和 disturb（打擾）只有開頭一樣，字根不同；contribute（貢獻）是同一個 -tribute 家族。

words.meaning: 行銷；推銷；推廣（market 的過去式／過去分詞）

sentences.en: The new sports drink will be marketed to professional athletes and people who exercise at the gym regularly.
sentences.zh: 這款新運動飲料會以職業運動員和常上健身房的人為行銷對象。

sentences.en: The smartphone was marketed as the lightest model on the market, which helped boost sales.
sentences.zh: 這支手機主打市面上最輕的機型，幫助提升了銷量。

sentences.en: Our skin care products are mainly marketed to young women between the ages of twenty and thirty.
sentences.zh: 我們的保養品主要是賣給二十到三十歲的年輕女性。

sentences.en: The company marketed its new healthy snacks mainly through social media instead of traditional television advertisements.
sentences.zh: 公司主要透過社群媒體推廣新的健康零食，而不是傳統電視廣告。

sentences.en: This laptop is marketed as an affordable option for students who need a computer for online classes.
sentences.zh: 這台筆電主打給需要上線上課程的學生，是平價的選擇。

words.note: 語塊：be marketed to＋人（以……為行銷對象）、be marketed as＋賣點（主打是……）、market a product（推銷產品）。market 當名詞是「市場」，當動詞是「行銷、推銷」；marketing＝行銷（marketing department 行銷部）。⚠️ 和 marked（標記了）只差兩個字母。

sentences.en: As the company's largest shareholder, Mr. Wang has a strong influence on important business decisions.
sentences.zh: 王先生是公司最大的股東，對重要的商業決策很有影響力。

sentences.en: Every shareholder will receive a copy of the annual report before the general meeting in June.
sentences.zh: 每位股東都會在六月的股東大會前收到一份年報。

sentences.en: The CEO sent a letter to each shareholder explaining why profits fell during the last quarter.
sentences.zh: 執行長寄信給每位股東，說明上一季獲利下滑的原因。

sentences.en: Ms. Chen became a major shareholder after buying ten percent of the company's stock last year.
sentences.zh: 陳小姐去年買下公司一成的股份後，成為主要股東。

sentences.en: During the annual meeting, one shareholder asked the board to explain the high costs of the new factory.
sentences.zh: 年度大會上，一位股東要求董事會說明新工廠成本很高的原因。

words.note: 語塊：major／largest shareholder（大股東）、shareholders' meeting／annual general meeting（股東大會）、shareholder value（股東價值）。share（股份）＋holder（持有人）。同義詞 stockholder。容易搞混：stakeholder 是「利害關係人」，範圍更廣，員工、客戶、社區都算。

words.meaning: 消耗（能源、時間）；食用；吃喝

sentences.en: The new printers consume far less electricity than the old models we used last year.
sentences.zh: 新的印表機比我們去年用的舊機型省電很多。

sentences.en: Please consume the salad within two days of purchase and keep it in the refrigerator.
sentences.zh: 沙拉請在購買後兩天內食用，並放在冰箱冷藏。

sentences.en: Long meetings that consume too much of the day can lower productivity across the entire department.
sentences.zh: 佔掉一整天太多時間的冗長會議，會降低整個部門的效率。

sentences.en: Large trucks consume a lot of fuel, so the company is testing electric vehicles for local deliveries.
sentences.zh: 大卡車很耗油，所以公司正在測試用電動車做市區配送。

sentences.en: Visitors are not allowed to consume food or drinks inside the museum's main exhibition halls or the library.
sentences.zh: 參觀者不可以在博物館主展廳或圖書館內飲食。

words.note: 語塊：consume energy／electricity／fuel（消耗能源／電／燃料）、consume time（花時間）、consume food or drinks（飲食，比 eat／drink 正式）、consume within … days（……天內食用）。名詞 consumption（消耗量），consumer（消費者）。長很像的字：assume（假設）、resume（恢復、重新開始）。

words.meaning: 烘焙食品（麵包、蛋糕、餅乾等）

sentences.en: The bakery on Main Street sells fresh bread, cakes, and other baked goods every morning.
sentences.zh: 大街上的麵包店每天早上賣新鮮麵包、蛋糕和其他烘焙食品。

sentences.en: All baked goods are made in our kitchen each morning and sold at half price after eight p.m.
sentences.zh: 所有烘焙食品都是每天早上在我們廚房現做，晚上八點後半價出售。

sentences.en: The café's baked goods, such as muffins and cookies, are popular with office workers during breaks.
sentences.zh: 這家咖啡店的瑪芬、餅乾等烘焙點心，很受上班族休息時間歡迎。

sentences.en: Please label any baked goods containing nuts so that customers with allergies can avoid them.
sentences.zh: 含有堅果的烘焙食品請貼上標示，讓會過敏的客人可以避開。

sentences.en: Our hotel offers complimentary coffee and freshly baked goods in the main lobby every afternoon from three to five.
sentences.zh: 我們飯店每天下午三點到五點，在大廳免費提供咖啡和現烤點心。

words.note: 語塊：freshly baked goods（現烤點心）、sell baked goods（賣烘焙食品）。baked（烤過的，bake 的過去分詞）＋goods（商品、貨品）。goods 永遠是複數，所以要說 baked goods，不說 a baked good。⚠️ 拼法：baked（烤的），不是 backed（被支持的）。

words.meaning: 可能會（被改變、受影響）；須經過（批准）；須繳（稅）

sentences.en: All prices listed on our website are subject to change at any time without prior notice.
sentences.zh: 網站上的所有價格可能隨時調整，恕不另行通知。

sentences.en: The tour schedule is subject to change depending on the weather conditions and traffic on the day of the trip.
sentences.zh: 行程可能依出發當天的天氣和交通狀況調整。

sentences.en: Your loan application is subject to final approval by the bank's credit department within five business days.
sentences.zh: 您的貸款申請須經銀行授信部門在五個工作天內做最後核准。

sentences.en: Imported goods are subject to a ten percent tax when they arrive at the port.
sentences.zh: 進口貨物抵達港口時，須課徵百分之十的稅。

sentences.en: The amount of each ingredient is subject to change if the recipe is adjusted for larger groups.
sentences.zh: 如果食譜調整成大份量，每種材料的用量都可能會改變。

words.note: 語塊：be subject to change（可能會變動，公告超常見）、be subject to approval（須經核准）、be subject to tax／a fee（須繳稅／付費）。subject to 後面接名詞。別搞混：submit to（服從、提交給）、object to（反對）。

sentences.en: Bananas are rich in potassium, which helps the body control blood pressure and muscle movement.
sentences.zh: 香蕉富含鉀，可以幫助身體控制血壓和肌肉活動。

sentences.en: Our new sports drink contains extra potassium to help athletes recover quickly after long workouts.
sentences.zh: 我們的新運動飲料額外添加了鉀，幫助運動員在長時間訓練後快速恢復。

sentences.en: The doctor told Mr. Lee to eat more vegetables because his potassium levels were too low.
sentences.zh: 醫生要李先生多吃蔬菜，因為他的鉀含量太低。

sentences.en: Each bottle lists the amount of potassium and sodium on the nutrition label on the back.
sentences.zh: 每瓶背面的營養標示上都有列出鉀和鈉的含量。

sentences.en: Foods that are high in potassium, such as potatoes and spinach, are part of a healthy diet.
sentences.zh: 馬鈴薯、菠菜這類高鉀食物，是健康飲食的一部分。

words.note: 語塊：rich in／high in potassium（富含鉀）、potassium levels（鉀含量）。營養標示常見礦物質：sodium（鈉）、calcium（鈣）、iron（鐵）、magnesium（鎂）。發音 puh-TAS-ee-um，重音在第二音節。

sentences.en: Doctors recommend choosing soups that are low in sodium to help keep blood pressure healthy.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議選擇低鈉的湯，幫助維持健康的血壓。

sentences.en: The company reduced the amount of sodium in its instant noodles by thirty percent this year.
sentences.zh: 公司今年把泡麵的鈉含量減少了三成。

sentences.en: Eating too much processed food can lead to a high sodium intake, which may cause health problems.
sentences.zh: 吃太多加工食品會讓鈉攝取量過高，可能造成健康問題。

sentences.en: The nutrition label shows that each bag of chips contains three hundred milligrams of sodium.
sentences.zh: 營養標示顯示，每包洋芋片含有三百毫克的鈉。

sentences.en: Our chefs use herbs and lemon instead of salt to keep the sodium content of every dish low.
sentences.zh: 我們的廚師用香草和檸檬代替鹽，讓每道菜的鈉含量都很低。

words.note: 語塊：low in sodium／low-sodium（低鈉）、high in sodium（高鈉）、sodium intake（鈉攝取量）、sodium content（鈉含量）。鹽的化學名稱是 sodium chloride（氯化鈉）。和 potassium（鉀）常一起出現在營養標示上。發音 SO-dee-um。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin's friendly personality makes her a great fit for our busy customer service team.
sentences.zh: 林小姐個性親切，很適合我們忙碌的客服團隊。

sentences.en: We are looking for a salesperson with an outgoing personality, a positive attitude, and strong communication skills.
sentences.zh: 我們在找個性外向、態度正面、溝通能力強的業務人員。

sentences.en: The job interview included a short online test to identify each candidate's main personality traits and work style.
sentences.zh: 面試包含一個簡短的線上測驗，了解每位應徵者主要的人格特質和工作風格。

sentences.en: Although he is very quiet, Mr. Park has a strong personality and is not afraid to share his opinions.
sentences.zh: 朴先生雖然很安靜，但個性很強，敢說出自己的意見。

sentences.en: Many customers love the café because the owner's warm personality makes everyone feel welcome and relaxed.
sentences.zh: 很多客人喜歡這家咖啡店，因為老闆個性溫暖，讓大家覺得很自在。

words.note: 語塊：outgoing／friendly personality（外向／親切的個性）、strong personality（個性很強）、personality traits（人格特質）、a good fit for one's personality（適合某人的個性）。和 character 的差別：personality 偏「外在表現出來的個性」，character 偏「品格、道德」。別搞混 personnel（全體員工、人事）。

sentences.en: Please arrive fifteen minutes early for your job interview and bring a copy of your résumé.
sentences.zh: 面試請提早十五分鐘到，並帶一份履歷。

sentences.en: The human resources manager will conduct the second interview with the top three candidates next week.
sentences.zh: 人資經理下週會和前三名應徵者進行第二輪面試。

sentences.en: We would like to schedule an interview with you on Thursday afternoon at two o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我們想跟您約週四下午兩點面試。

sentences.en: During the interview, Ms. Chen talked about her five years of experience in international sales.
sentences.zh: 面試時，陳小姐談到她五年的國際業務經驗。

sentences.en: The newspaper published an interview with the company's founder about her plans for expansion overseas.
sentences.zh: 報紙刊登了一篇對公司創辦人的專訪，談她拓展海外的計畫。

words.note: 語塊：job interview（工作面試）、have／attend an interview（去面試）、schedule an interview（安排面試）、conduct an interview（進行面試）、an interview with＋人（對某人的訪談）。interview 也可以當動詞：interview candidates（面試應徵者）。面試官 interviewer，被面試的人 interviewee。

sentences.en: The popular Korean TV drama was filmed at several famous locations around Seoul last year.
sentences.zh: 那部很紅的韓劇去年在首爾幾個知名景點拍攝。

sentences.en: Our company's new office appeared in a TV drama, which brought many curious visitors to the building.
sentences.zh: 我們公司的新辦公室出現在一部電視劇裡，吸引很多好奇的訪客來大樓參觀。

sentences.en: The streaming service will release a new TV drama about life in a busy Taipei hospital next month.
sentences.zh: 這個串流平台下個月會推出一部關於台北忙碌醫院生活的新劇。

sentences.en: Ms. Wu learned a lot of everyday English by watching an American TV drama with subtitles.
sentences.zh: 吳小姐靠看有字幕的美劇，學會了很多生活英文。

sentences.en: The actor became famous after starring in a TV drama that was shown in more than twenty countries.
sentences.zh: 這位演員主演了一部在二十多個國家播出的電視劇後爆紅。

words.note: 語塊：Korean／Japanese／American TV drama（韓劇／日劇／美劇）、star in a TV drama（主演電視劇）、binge-watch a TV drama（追劇、一次看很多集）。美式也常說 TV series 或 TV show；一集是 an episode，一季是 a season。

words.meaning: 擴展（業務）；拓展到新領域（branch out 的過去式）

sentences.en: After ten years of selling shoes, the company branched out into handbags and other leather goods.
sentences.zh: 賣了十年的鞋子後，公司把業務擴展到手提包和其他皮件。

sentences.en: The restaurant chain has branched out from Taiwanese food to offer Japanese and Korean dishes as well.
sentences.zh: 這家連鎖餐廳從台菜拓展到也提供日式和韓式料理。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin started as a wedding photographer but later branched out into video production for businesses.
sentences.zh: 林小姐一開始是婚禮攝影師，後來拓展到幫企業拍影片。

sentences.en: Our bakery branched out last year by opening three small cafés in local train stations.
sentences.zh: 我們麵包店去年拓展業務，在當地火車站開了三家小咖啡店。

sentences.en: Having branched out from its original software business, the firm now also sells computers and tablets.
sentences.zh: 這家公司從原本的軟體業務擴展出去，現在也賣電腦和平板。

words.note: 語塊：branch out into＋新領域（擴展到……）、branch out from＋原本的領域（從……拓展出去）。branch 是「樹枝；分公司」，就像樹從主幹長出新的樹枝。別搞混：broke out（爆發）、burned out（累垮了）。

words.meaning: 有權（得到／做）的；（書、演講）標題為……的

sentences.en: All full-time employees are entitled to fifteen days of paid vacation each year, plus five additional sick days.
sentences.zh: 所有全職員工每年享有十五天特休，另外還有五天病假。

sentences.en: Customers who spend over five hundred dollars are entitled to free delivery within the city.
sentences.zh: 消費超過五百元的顧客，市區內可享免運。

sentences.en: Members of our loyalty program are entitled to a ten percent discount on all purchases.
sentences.zh: 我們會員計畫的會員，所有消費都享九折。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim gave a presentation entitled "Building Strong Customer Relationships" at the annual sales conference in Seoul last week.
sentences.zh: 金小姐上週在首爾的年度業務大會上，發表了一場題為「建立穩固的客戶關係」的簡報。

sentences.en: Passengers are entitled to a full refund if their flight is canceled by the airline.
sentences.zh: 如果班機被航空公司取消，乘客有權全額退款。

words.note: 語塊：be entitled to＋名詞（有權享有……）、be entitled to＋動詞（有權做……）、a book／presentation entitled…（標題為……的書／簡報）。動詞 entitle（給予權利；給……命名），名詞 entitlement（權利）。多益的福利、退款、會員公告超常見。

sentences.en: The company is considered a pioneer in electric cars and has inspired many other automakers.
sentences.zh: 這家公司被視為電動車的先驅，啟發了很多其他車廠。

sentences.en: Dr. Chen was a pioneer of online education in Taiwan, launching her first course in 1998.
sentences.zh: 陳博士是台灣線上教育的先驅，1998 年就推出第一門課。

sentences.en: As a pioneer in renewable energy, our firm built the country's first large solar farm.
sentences.zh: 身為再生能源的開拓者，我們公司蓋了國內第一座大型太陽能發電場。

sentences.en: The museum's new exhibit honors a pioneer who helped develop the city's first public railway.
sentences.zh: 博物館的新展覽向一位先驅致敬，他協助建立了這座城市的第一條公共鐵路。

sentences.en: Ms. Ito is known as a pioneer in the field of mobile banking across Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 伊藤小姐被公認為東南亞行動銀行領域的先鋒。

words.note: 語塊：a pioneer in／of＋領域（……的先驅）、pioneering work（開創性的工作）。pioneer 也可以當動詞：pioneer a new technology（率先開發新技術）。發音 pai-uh-NEER，重音在最後。

words.meaning: 暗示；意味著（沒有直接說出來）

sentences.en: The manager's comments seemed to imply that the project would be delayed until next year.
sentences.zh: 經理的話似乎暗示這個專案會延到明年。

sentences.en: A small drop in sales does not necessarily imply that customers are unhappy with our products.
sentences.zh: 業績小幅下滑，不一定代表顧客對我們的產品不滿意。

sentences.en: Her silence during the meeting may imply that she does not agree with the new plan.
sentences.zh: 她在會議上不說話，可能暗示她不同意新計畫。

sentences.en: The report did not directly say the factory would close, but it seemed to imply it.
sentences.zh: 報告沒有直接說工廠會關，但看起來是在暗示這件事。

sentences.en: Low prices do not always imply low quality, so please read the product reviews carefully.
sentences.zh: 價格低不一定代表品質差，所以請仔細看商品評論。

words.note: 語塊：imply that＋句子（暗示……）、seem to imply（似乎在暗示）、not necessarily imply（不一定代表）。名詞 implication（含意；影響）。⚠️ 別搞混：implement（執行、實施）長得像但意思完全不同；infer 是「推論出」，說話的人 imply，聽的人 infer。

words.meaning: 證明……是合理的；為……辯護；說明理由

sentences.en: The manager had to justify the high cost of the new software to the board of directors.
sentences.zh: 經理必須向董事會說明，新軟體這麼貴是合理的。

sentences.en: It is hard to justify spending so much money on advertising when sales are falling.
sentences.zh: 業績在下滑時，很難說服大家花這麼多錢打廣告是合理的。

sentences.en: Please prepare a short report to justify your decision to hire two more temporary workers.
sentences.zh: 請準備一份簡短報告，說明你決定多請兩位臨時工的理由。

sentences.en: The excellent results of the trial program justify expanding it to all of our stores next year.
sentences.zh: 試辦計畫的成果很好，證明明年擴大到所有門市是合理的。

sentences.en: Can you justify the extra expense of first-class flight tickets for such a short two-hour business trip?
sentences.zh: 這麼短的兩小時出差，你能說明為什麼要多花錢買頭等艙機票嗎？

words.note: 語塊：justify the cost／expense（說明費用是合理的）、justify a decision（為決定提出理由）、hard to justify（很難說得過去）。名詞 justification（正當理由），形容詞 justified（有道理的）。字根 just＝公正、合理，justify＝讓它變得合理。

sentences.en: The company president paid tribute to the retiring employees for their many years of hard work.
sentences.zh: 公司總裁向即將退休的員工致敬，感謝他們多年來的辛勞。

sentences.en: The concert was a tribute to the famous Taiwanese singer who passed away earlier last year.
sentences.zh: 這場音樂會是為了紀念去年初過世的知名台灣歌手。

sentences.en: At the awards dinner, the CEO paid tribute to the volunteers who helped after the earthquake.
sentences.zh: 在頒獎晚宴上，執行長向地震後協助救災的志工致敬。

sentences.en: The new library was named after the city's first mayor as a tribute to his public service.
sentences.zh: 新圖書館以第一任市長命名，紀念他對公眾的貢獻。

sentences.en: Employees wore blue shirts in tribute to the company founder on the fiftieth anniversary of the firm.
sentences.zh: 公司五十週年時，員工穿藍色襯衫向創辦人致敬。

words.note: 語塊：pay tribute to＋人（向……致敬）、a tribute to＋人（獻給……的紀念）、in tribute to（為了紀念……）。字根 tribute＝給（獻給某人），和 contribute、distribute 同一家族。tribute band 是「致敬樂團」，專門翻唱某個知名樂團的歌。

words.meaning: 紀念碑；紀念建築；歷史古蹟

sentences.en: Thousands of tourists visit the historic monument in the old city center every summer to take photos.
sentences.zh: 每年夏天都有成千上萬的遊客到老城區的歷史古蹟拍照。

sentences.en: The town built a stone monument to honor the workers who helped build the railway.
sentences.zh: 小鎮立了一座石碑，紀念協助建造鐵路的工人。

sentences.en: Our hotel is just a five-minute walk from the national monument and the main shopping street.
sentences.zh: 我們飯店走路五分鐘就到國家紀念碑和主要的購物街。

sentences.en: A monument to the company's founder stands in front of the headquarters building in Taipei.
sentences.zh: 台北總部大樓前立著一座紀念公司創辦人的紀念碑。

sentences.en: The city government plans to repair the old monument before the tourist season begins next spring.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫在明年春天觀光旺季開始前修復這座老古蹟。

words.note: 語塊：historic monument（歷史古蹟）、a monument to＋人（紀念……的碑）、build／erect a monument（立紀念碑）。形容詞 monumental（巨大的、意義重大的）。拼法：mo-nu-ment（中間是 nu），別寫成 momument；和 moment（時刻）只差一點。

words.meaning: 官員；公務員；（機構的）負責人員

sentences.en: A former government official will give a speech about trade policy at next week's business forum.
sentences.zh: 一位前政府官員將在下週的商業論壇上演講，談貿易政策。
