sentences.en: A senior official from the ministry met with local business owners to discuss the new tax rules.
sentences.zh: 部會的一位高層官員和當地企業主會面，討論新的稅法規定。

sentences.en: According to a city official, the new subway line will open to passengers in December.
sentences.zh: 根據一位市府官員的說法，新的捷運線將在十二月開放乘客搭乘。

sentences.en: The company hired a former official from the Ministry of Finance as its new legal adviser.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一位前財政部官員擔任新的法律顧問。

sentences.en: Every visitor must be accompanied by an official from the factory during the safety inspection.
sentences.zh: 安全檢查期間，每位訪客都必須由工廠的負責人員陪同。

words.note: 語塊：government official（政府官員）、senior official（高層官員）、former official（前官員）、city official（市府官員）。official 當形容詞是「正式的、官方的」（official website 官網、official announcement 正式公告）；當名詞是「官員」。別搞混 officer（軍官、警官；公司的高階主管）和 office（辦公室）。

words.meaning: 專業精神；專業表現；敬業態度

sentences.en: Our clients often say they appreciate the professionalism of our staff, especially their quick and polite responses.
sentences.zh: 客戶常說很欣賞我們員工的專業，特別是他們回覆又快又有禮貌。

sentences.en: We can always rely on their professionalism, even when deadlines are very tight and the work is difficult.
sentences.zh: 即使期限很趕、工作很難，我們也總是可以信賴他們的專業。

sentences.en: The hotel manager praised the team for their professionalism and patience during the very busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 飯店經理稱讚團隊在忙碌的假期旺季中表現專業又有耐心。

sentences.en: Dressing neatly and arriving on time are simple ways to show professionalism at a job interview.
sentences.zh: 穿著整齊、準時到，是面試時展現專業的簡單方法。

sentences.en: Customers often judge a company's professionalism by how quickly it answers emails and phone calls.
sentences.zh: 顧客常常用回信和接電話的速度，來判斷一家公司夠不夠專業。

words.note: 語塊：rely on someone's professionalism（信賴某人的專業）、show／demonstrate professionalism（展現專業）、a high level of professionalism（高度專業）。⚠️ 多益常考詞性：their／his 後面要接名詞 professionalism；professional 是形容詞（a professional attitude）或「專業人士」（a professional）。

sentences.en: Please check the travel itinerary carefully and let us know if you need to change any flight times.
sentences.zh: 請仔細確認旅遊行程表，如果需要改任何航班時間請告訴我們。

sentences.en: The tour company sent each guest a detailed itinerary listing all hotels, meals, and activities for the trip.
sentences.zh: 旅行社寄給每位旅客一份詳細行程表，列出這趟旅程所有的飯店、餐點和活動。

sentences.en: Our assistant will finalize the itinerary for the sales trip to Japan by Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們的助理會在週五下午前確定日本業務出差的行程。

sentences.en: The itinerary includes a factory visit in Osaka and a meeting with clients in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 行程包括參觀大阪的工廠，以及和東京的客戶開會。

sentences.en: Due to the typhoon, the airline had to change the itinerary for all passengers flying to Okinawa.
sentences.zh: 因為颱風，航空公司必須更改所有飛往沖繩旅客的行程。

words.note: 語塊：travel itinerary（旅遊行程表）、a detailed itinerary（詳細行程）、plan／finalize an itinerary（規劃／確定行程）、The itinerary includes…（行程包括……）。和 schedule 的差別：schedule 是一般的時間表；itinerary 專指旅行或出差的路線和行程。發音 ai-TIN-uh-rair-ee。

sentences.en: The new pizza pans are thirty centimeters in diameter, which is perfect for family-size orders.
sentences.zh: 新的披薩烤盤直徑三十公分，很適合家庭號的訂單。

sentences.en: Please measure the diameter of each pipe before ordering any replacement parts from our main supplier.
sentences.zh: 向我們的主要供應商訂替換零件前，請先量好每根水管的直徑。

sentences.en: The company makes metal wheels that are about fifty centimeters in diameter for delivery carts.
sentences.zh: 這家公司生產直徑大約五十公分的金屬輪子，用在送貨推車上。

sentences.en: The diameter of the round meeting table is two meters, so it can seat up to ten people.
sentences.zh: 圓形會議桌的直徑是兩公尺，最多可以坐十個人。

sentences.en: Our engineers increased the diameter of the cooling fan to make the machine run more quietly.
sentences.zh: 我們的工程師加大了散熱風扇的直徑，讓機器運轉得更安靜。

words.note: 語塊：… centimeters in diameter（直徑……公分）、the diameter of＋東西（……的直徑）。相關字：radius（半徑）、circumference（圓周）、perimeter（周長）。dia＝穿過，meter＝測量 → 穿過圓心量的長度。

words.meaning: 警告；提醒（注意危險或問題）

sentences.en: Please warn new employees about the wet floor near the kitchen entrance before they start work.
sentences.zh: 新員工開始上班前，請提醒他們廚房入口附近地板很濕。

sentences.en: The manager asked us to warn customers that the store will close early on Friday.
sentences.zh: 經理請我們提醒顧客，店週五會提早關門。

sentences.en: Signs at the factory warn visitors not to touch any machines without a staff member present.
sentences.zh: 工廠裡的告示警告訪客，沒有員工在場時不要碰任何機器。

sentences.en: Our system will automatically warn you of any unusual or suspicious activity on your online bank account.
sentences.zh: 我們的系統會在你的網路銀行帳戶有異常或可疑活動時自動警告你。

sentences.en: Experts warn that rising shipping costs could increase the price of imported goods next year.
sentences.zh: 專家警告，運費上漲可能讓明年進口商品的價格上升。

words.note: 語塊：warn＋人＋about／of＋事情（提醒某人注意……）、warn＋人＋(not) to＋動詞（警告某人（不要）做……）、warn that＋句子（警告說……）。名詞 warning（警告），例如 a warning sign（警告標誌）。發音 [wɔrn]，跟 worn（穿過的）一樣，和 warm（溫暖的）不同。

words.meaning: （電影的）放映；（展覽的）展出；（房屋的）看屋

sentences.en: More than two hundred guests attended a special showing of the new film at the downtown theater.
sentences.zh: 兩百多位來賓參加了市中心戲院這部新電影的特別放映會。

sentences.en: The real estate agent arranged a private showing of the apartment for the young couple on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 房仲週六幫這對年輕夫妻安排私人看屋。

sentences.en: The museum offers a free showing of the documentary every Sunday afternoon in the main hall.
sentences.zh: 博物館每週日下午在大廳免費播放這部紀錄片。

sentences.en: After the first showing sold out, the theater added three more screenings for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 第一場放映賣光後，戲院週末又加開了三場。

sentences.en: Please arrive early for the house showing because the owners will leave at four o'clock.
sentences.zh: 看屋請提早到，因為屋主四點就要離開。

words.note: 語塊：attend a showing（參加放映會／看屋）、a special／private showing（特別／私人放映、看屋）、a house／property showing（看房子）。和 screening 很像（電影放映），showing 還可以用在房屋買賣和展覽。

words.meaning: 房屋貸款；房貸；抵押貸款

sentences.en: The young couple applied for a mortgage to buy their first apartment near the train station.
sentences.zh: 這對年輕夫妻申請房貸，要買他們在火車站附近的第一間公寓。

sentences.en: Our bank offers low interest rates for customers who take out a mortgage before the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 年底前申辦房貸的客戶，我們銀行提供低利率。

sentences.en: After twenty years of monthly payments, Mr. Lin finally paid off his mortgage last spring.
sentences.zh: 每個月繳了二十年，林先生終於在去年春天還清房貸。

sentences.en: Rising interest rates have made mortgage payments more expensive for many families in the city.
sentences.zh: 利率上升讓這座城市很多家庭的房貸月付金變得更貴。

sentences.en: Before applying, please prepare your salary records, since the bank will review them for the mortgage.
sentences.zh: 申請前請準備好薪資證明，因為銀行會審核這些資料來決定房貸。

words.note: 語塊：apply for a mortgage（申請房貸）、take out a mortgage（辦房貸）、pay off a mortgage（還清房貸）、mortgage payments（房貸月付）。⚠️ 發音：t 不發音，唸 MOR-gij。和 loan 的差別：loan 是一般貸款，mortgage 專指用房子抵押的貸款。

words.meaning: 情勢的轉變；事情的（意外）發展

sentences.en: Given this turn of events, the company has decided to delay the opening of its new store.
sentences.zh: 考慮到情勢的轉變，公司決定延後新店開幕。

sentences.en: In a surprising turn of events, the smaller firm won the contract over its biggest rival.
sentences.zh: 出乎意料的是，這家較小的公司打敗最大的對手拿下合約。

sentences.en: The sudden turn of events forced the airline to cancel all flights to the island.
sentences.zh: 突如其來的變化，迫使航空公司取消所有飛往這座島的班機。

sentences.en: Nobody expected this turn of events when the construction project first started two years ago in March.
sentences.zh: 兩年前三月工程剛開始時，沒有人料到事情會這樣發展。

sentences.en: After an unexpected turn of events, the CEO announced that she would retire at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 在一連串意外的變化之後，執行長宣布她將在月底退休。

words.note: 語塊：given this turn of events（考慮到情勢的轉變）、in a surprising／an unexpected turn of events（出乎意料地）、a sudden turn of events（突然的變化）。turn＝轉彎，事情突然「轉彎」，往意想不到的方向發展。注意 events 要用複數。

words.meaning: （訊號、聲音、引擎）突然中斷、斷掉；戒掉（某種食物）；剪下

sentences.en: My phone signal tends to cut out whenever I take the train through the tunnel near the station.
sentences.zh: 每次搭火車經過車站附近的隧道，我的手機訊號就容易斷掉。

sentences.en: The sound began to cut out during the video conference, so we had to call the client back.
sentences.zh: 視訊會議時聲音開始斷斷續續，所以我們只好再回撥給客戶。

sentences.en: The engine of the delivery truck suddenly cut out on the highway, causing a long delay.
sentences.zh: 送貨卡車的引擎在高速公路上突然熄火，造成很長的延誤。

sentences.en: The doctor advised Mr. Chen to cut out sugary drinks to improve his health and lose weight.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議陳先生戒掉含糖飲料，改善健康也減重。

sentences.en: If the Wi-Fi connection continues to cut out, please contact our technical support team for help.
sentences.zh: 如果無線網路還是一直斷線，請聯絡我們的技術支援團隊。

words.note: 語塊：the signal／sound／connection cuts out（訊號／聲音／連線斷掉）、the engine cuts out（引擎熄火）、cut out sugar／junk food（戒掉糖／垃圾食物）。和 cut off 很像：cut off 是「被切斷」（The call was cut off），cut out 常指「自己時有時無、斷斷續續」。

words.meaning: 類似那樣的；差不多那個意思；那一類的

sentences.en: We need a catchy slogan, something like "Fresh Every Day" or something along those lines.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一句好記的標語，像「天天新鮮」，或類似那樣的。

sentences.en: The client wants a modern logo with blue and green colors, or something along those lines.
sentences.zh: 客戶想要一個藍綠色的現代感標誌，或差不多那種感覺的。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee suggested offering free delivery or a small gift, or anything else along those lines.
sentences.zh: 李小姐建議提供免運或小禮物，或其他類似的東西。

sentences.en: If you have any other ideas along those lines, please share them at Friday's marketing meeting.
sentences.zh: 如果你有其他類似的點子，請在週五的行銷會議上分享。

sentences.en: The manager said the budget might be cut by ten percent, or something along those lines.
sentences.zh: 經理說預算可能會砍一成左右，大概是那樣。

words.note: 語塊：something along those lines（類似那樣的東西）、or something along those lines（……之類的，放句尾）、ideas along those lines（類似的點子）。口語超常用，說話時不確定細節、只是舉個例子時用。也可以說 along these lines（類似這樣的）。

sentences.en: A street vendor near the station sells hot sweet potatoes and fresh juice every morning.
sentences.zh: 車站附近有個攤販每天早上賣烤地瓜和新鮮果汁。

sentences.en: The company is looking for a reliable software vendor to update its online ordering system.
sentences.zh: 公司正在找一家可靠的軟體廠商，來更新網路訂購系統。

sentences.en: Each food vendor at the night market must have a valid license from the city government.
sentences.zh: 夜市的每個小吃攤販都必須有市政府核發的有效執照。

sentences.en: Please compare the prices from at least three suppliers before choosing a vendor for the office chairs.
sentences.zh: 選定辦公椅的廠商前，請先比較至少三家供應商的價格。

sentences.en: The festival organizers will charge each vendor a small fee to set up a booth in the park.
sentences.zh: 活動主辦單位會向每個攤商收一點費用，讓他們在公園擺攤。

words.note: 語塊：street vendor（路邊攤販）、food vendor（小吃攤）、software vendor（軟體廠商）、choose a vendor（選定廠商）。和 supplier 很像：supplier 偏「供應原料、貨物給公司的人」，vendor 範圍更廣，路邊賣東西的小販也算。動詞 vend＝販賣，vending machine＝自動販賣機。

words.meaning: 複雜的情況；（意外的）問題；（醫學）併發症

sentences.en: The project was delayed because of an unexpected complication with the building permit for the new warehouse.
sentences.zh: 因為新倉庫的建築許可出了意外的問題，專案延誤了。

sentences.en: The surgery went smoothly, and the doctor said there was no sign of any complication afterward.
sentences.zh: 手術很順利，醫生說之後沒有任何併發症的跡象。

sentences.en: Bad weather added another complication to the already difficult task of delivering supplies to the island.
sentences.zh: 把物資送到島上本來就很難，壞天氣又讓情況更複雜。

sentences.en: If any complication arises during the software installation, please call our technical support team immediately.
sentences.zh: 安裝軟體時如果發生任何問題，請立刻打電話給我們的技術支援團隊。

sentences.en: Changing suppliers at the last minute could create a serious complication for our production schedule.
sentences.zh: 最後一刻更換供應商，可能會讓我們的生產時程出大問題。

words.note: 語塊：an unexpected complication（意外的問題）、a complication arises（出現問題）、cause／create complications（造成麻煩）、complications from surgery（手術併發症）。動詞 complicate（使複雜），形容詞 complicated（複雜的）。長很像的字：compilation（彙編）、compliment（讚美）。

words.meaning: 執行；實施；落實（計畫、政策、系統）

sentences.en: The company will implement a new security system in all of its offices next month.
sentences.zh: 公司下個月會在所有辦公室導入新的保全系統。

sentences.en: It took the team six months to fully implement the changes recommended by the consultants.
sentences.zh: 團隊花了六個月才完全落實顧問建議的改變。

sentences.en: The government plans to implement a new policy to reduce plastic waste in restaurants and convenience stores.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫實施新政策，減少餐廳和便利商店的塑膠垃圾。

sentences.en: Before we implement the new schedule, please collect feedback from all of the employees involved.
sentences.zh: 在實施新班表之前，請先收集所有相關員工的意見。

sentences.en: The manager asked Ms. Wu to implement the marketing plan as soon as the budget was approved.
sentences.zh: 經理請吳小姐在預算一核准就馬上執行行銷計畫。

words.note: 語塊：implement a plan／policy／system（執行計畫／實施政策／導入系統）、implement changes（落實改變）、fully implement（完全落實）。名詞 implementation（實施、執行）。⚠️ 別和 imply（暗示）搞混。同義詞 carry out（執行），implement 比較正式，多益和公司文件很常見。

sentences.en: The new dress code will be applied uniformly to all employees, including managers and part-time staff.
sentences.zh: 新的服裝規定會一律適用於所有員工，包括主管和兼職人員。

sentences.en: Please spread the glue uniformly across the entire surface before attaching the wooden panels to the wall.
sentences.zh: 把木板貼到牆上之前，請把膠均勻地塗滿整個表面。

sentences.en: The heater is designed to warm the whole room uniformly, so no corner feels cold.
sentences.zh: 這台暖氣機的設計能讓整個房間均勻變暖，每個角落都不會冷。

sentences.en: Discounts must be offered uniformly in every branch across the country to avoid confusing our customers.
sentences.zh: 全國每家分店的折扣都必須一致，以免讓顧客搞混。

sentences.en: The workers painted the walls uniformly so that the color looked the same from every angle.
sentences.zh: 工人把牆壁漆得很均勻，從每個角度看顏色都一樣。

words.note: 語塊：be applied uniformly（一律適用）、spread uniformly（塗／分布得很均勻）、uniformly distributed（平均分布）。uni（一）＋form（形狀）＝都是同一個樣子；制服 uniform 就是「大家穿一樣」。同義詞：evenly（均勻地）、consistently（一致地）。

sentences.en: All new employees must sign a confidentiality agreement before they are allowed to access any customer records.
sentences.zh: 所有新員工都必須先簽保密協議，才能查看任何客戶資料。

sentences.en: Our law firm takes client confidentiality very seriously and never shares information with outside parties.
sentences.zh: 我們律師事務所非常重視客戶資料保密，從不把資訊透露給外部人士。

sentences.en: To maintain confidentiality, please do not discuss the merger with anyone outside the project team.
sentences.zh: 為了保密，請不要和專案團隊以外的人談論合併的事。

sentences.en: The hospital uses a secure system to protect patient confidentiality when sending medical reports to other doctors.
sentences.zh: 醫院把病歷寄給其他醫生時，會用安全的系統保護病人隱私。

sentences.en: Because of confidentiality rules, the manager could not share the candidate's salary details with us.
sentences.zh: 因為保密規定，經理不能告訴我們應徵者的薪資細節。

words.note: 語塊：confidentiality agreement（保密協議，也叫 NDA）、maintain／protect confidentiality（保密）、client／patient confidentiality（客戶／病人資料保密）。形容詞 confidential（機密的），例如 confidential documents（機密文件）。⚠️ 別和 confidence（信心）搞混。

words.meaning: 試鏡；試演；（樂團、表演的）甄選

sentences.en: More than three hundred singers attended the open audition for the new television talent show last Saturday.
sentences.zh: 上週六有三百多位歌手參加了新電視選秀節目的公開試鏡。

sentences.en: She practiced every evening for two months before her final audition for the national symphony orchestra.
sentences.zh: 她在國家交響樂團最後一輪甄選前，每天晚上練習了兩個月。

sentences.en: The theater company will hold an audition next Monday to find actors for its holiday musical.
sentences.zh: 劇團下週一會舉辦試鏡，為節慶音樂劇找演員。

sentences.en: Applicants who pass the first audition will be invited to perform again in front of the director.
sentences.zh: 通過第一輪試鏡的人，會被邀請在導演面前再表演一次。

sentences.en: Please bring a recent photo and your résumé when you arrive for the audition at nine o'clock.
sentences.zh: 九點來試鏡時，請帶一張近照和你的履歷。

words.note: 語塊：hold an audition（舉辦試鏡）、go to／attend an audition（去試鏡）、pass the audition（通過試鏡）、audition for＋角色（為……試鏡，這時 audition 是動詞）。字根 aud＝聽（audio、audience），原本是「表演給評審聽」。

sentences.en: The young actor got a small part in a commercial for a popular sports drink.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕演員在一支熱門運動飲料的廣告裡演了一個小角色。

sentences.en: Our company spent over one million dollars to film a television commercial for the new car.
sentences.zh: 我們公司花了一百多萬元幫新車拍電視廣告。

sentences.en: The new commercial will be shown on national television during the baseball finals next weekend.
sentences.zh: 新廣告下週末會在棒球總冠軍賽期間於全國電視播出。

sentences.en: Many viewers remembered the funny commercial and shared it with their friends on social media.
sentences.zh: 很多觀眾記得那支好笑的廣告，還在社群媒體上分享給朋友。

sentences.en: Ms. Wang was hired to write the script for a thirty-second radio commercial about the bank's new loans.
sentences.zh: 王小姐受聘為銀行新貸款方案寫一支三十秒廣播廣告的腳本。

words.note: 語塊：TV／radio commercial（電視／廣播廣告）、a part in a commercial（在廣告中的角色）、film／shoot a commercial（拍廣告）。和 advertisement 的差別：commercial 專指電視、廣播、影片的廣告；advertisement 範圍更廣，報紙、海報、網路廣告都算。commercial 當形容詞是「商業的」（commercial building 商業大樓）。

sentences.en: Customers can place their orders on a tablet at each table instead of waiting for a server.
sentences.zh: 客人可以用每張桌上的平板點餐，不用等服務生。

sentences.en: Every sales representative will receive a new tablet to show product videos and price lists to clients.
sentences.zh: 每位業務代表都會拿到一台新平板，用來給客戶看產品影片和價目表。

sentences.en: Please take one tablet twice a day after meals for seven days, and drink plenty of water.
sentences.zh: 請連續七天，每天兩次飯後吃一顆藥，並多喝水。

sentences.en: The hotel provides a tablet in each room so guests can order room service and book tours.
sentences.zh: 飯店每間房都有一台平板，房客可以點客房服務、預約導覽。

sentences.en: Our new app works on both a smartphone and a tablet, so you can study anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我們的新 App 在手機和平板上都能用，隨時隨地都能讀書。

words.note: 語塊：on a tablet（在平板上）、tablet computer（平板電腦）、take a tablet（吃一顆藥）。tablet 有兩個意思：①平板電腦（像 iPad）②藥片、錠劑（＝pill）。長很像的字：tabloid（八卦小報）。

sentences.en: The television station will air the new commercial during the evening news starting next Monday.
sentences.zh: 電視台從下週一開始，會在晚間新聞時段播出新廣告。

sentences.en: The company plans to air its holiday advertisement on three major television channels throughout December.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫整個十二月在三家主要電視台播出節慶廣告。

sentences.en: Due to the typhoon coverage, the network decided not to air the cooking show this week.
sentences.zh: 因為颱風新聞報導，電視台決定這週不播出料理節目。

sentences.en: Radio stations across the country will air the president's important speech live at nine on Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 全國的廣播電台會在週五早上九點現場播出總統的重要演說。

sentences.en: We need final approval from the client before we can air the thirty-second commercial on television.
sentences.zh: 我們要先拿到客戶的最後核准，才能在電視上播出這支三十秒廣告。

words.note: 語塊：air a commercial／show（播出廣告／節目）、be aired on TV（在電視上播出）、air live（現場直播）。air 名詞是「空氣」，當動詞是「播出」，因為節目是透過電波「放到空中」傳出去。on air＝正在播出中。

words.meaning: 換句話說；改寫（用自己的話重新表達）

sentences.en: Good paraphrasing skills help students and office workers explain difficult ideas clearly in their own words.
sentences.zh: 好的改寫能力，能幫學生和上班族用自己的話把難懂的概念說清楚。

sentences.en: By paraphrasing the customer's complaint, the agent showed that she had listened carefully and understood the problem.
sentences.zh: 客服人員把顧客的抱怨用自己的話重說一遍，表示她有仔細聽、也了解問題。

sentences.en: The training course includes a short lesson on paraphrasing so that reports do not copy other sources.
sentences.zh: 訓練課程有一堂簡短的改寫課，避免報告直接抄別人的內容。

sentences.en: Simple paraphrasing is not enough; you must also include the original source in your reference list.
sentences.zh: 光是改寫還不夠，你也必須在參考資料裡列出原本的出處。

sentences.en: Our editor is very good at paraphrasing long technical documents into short and easy summaries for clients.
sentences.zh: 我們的編輯很擅長把冗長的技術文件改寫成簡短好懂的摘要給客戶。

words.note: 語塊：paraphrasing skills（改寫能力）、by paraphrasing＋內容（透過換句話說）、paraphrase in your own words（用自己的話說）。動詞 paraphrase（改寫、換句話說）。para（旁邊）＋phrase（說法）＝換個說法。多益閱讀和聽力很常考「換句話說」：答案常常是原文的 paraphrase，不會一字不差。

sentences.en: Applicants must have a university diploma and at least two years of experience in sales.
sentences.zh: 應徵者必須有大學文憑，並有至少兩年業務經驗。

sentences.en: She received her high school diploma at the age of seventeen and then moved to Taipei.
sentences.zh: 她十七歲拿到高中畢業證書，之後搬到台北。

sentences.en: Please bring a copy of your diploma and your passport to the job interview on Monday.
sentences.zh: 週一面試時，請帶畢業證書影本和護照。

sentences.en: Mr. Lin holds a diploma in hotel management from a well-known hospitality school in Switzerland.
sentences.zh: 林先生有瑞士一所知名餐旅學校的飯店管理文憑。

sentences.en: The university will mail each graduate's diploma within six weeks after the graduation ceremony in June.
sentences.zh: 大學會在六月畢業典禮後六週內，把畢業證書寄給每位畢業生。

words.note: 語塊：university／high school diploma（大學／高中畢業證書）、receive a diploma（拿到畢業證書）、hold a diploma in＋科目（有……的文憑）。和 degree 的差別：degree 是「學位」本身（bachelor's degree 學士、master's degree 碩士），diploma 是證明你畢業的那張「證書」。doctorate 是博士學位。

sentences.en: The company hired an independent auditing firm to review its financial records for the past three years.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一家獨立的會計師事務所，審核過去三年的財務紀錄。

sentences.en: Internal auditing helps managers find mistakes in company spending before they become serious financial problems.
sentences.zh: 內部稽核能幫主管在公司支出的錯誤變成嚴重財務問題之前就發現。

sentences.en: Ms. Kao has more than ten years of experience in auditing and accounting for large banks.
sentences.zh: 高小姐有十多年替大型銀行做審計和會計的經驗。

sentences.en: The auditing process usually takes about four weeks and requires full access to all sales records.
sentences.zh: 審計流程通常大約需要四週，而且要能查看所有銷售紀錄。

sentences.en: All branches must follow the new auditing standards that were introduced by the head office in January.
sentences.zh: 所有分公司都必須遵守總公司一月推出的新稽核標準。

words.note: 語塊：auditing firm（會計師事務所、審計公司）、internal auditing（內部稽核）、the auditing process（審計流程）。動詞／名詞 audit（審計、查帳），做審計的人是 auditor（稽核員、審計師）。⚠️ 別和 audition（試鏡）搞混，兩個都來自 aud（聽）。美式口語 audit a class 是「旁聽一門課」。

words.meaning: 修剪；剪短；削減（成本、預算）；精簡

sentences.en: The gardener will trim the bushes in front of the office building every two weeks.
sentences.zh: 園丁每兩週會修剪辦公大樓前的灌木叢。

sentences.en: To stay within budget, the company plans to trim travel costs by twenty percent next year.
sentences.zh: 為了不超出預算，公司計畫明年把差旅費削減兩成。

sentences.en: Please trim the report to two pages so the directors can read it before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 請把報告精簡到兩頁，讓董事們在開會前看完。

sentences.en: The hair salon offers a quick free service to trim customers' bangs between their regular appointments.
sentences.zh: 這家美髮店提供快速的免費修瀏海服務，客人在兩次預約之間都可以來。

sentences.en: The restaurant decided to trim its menu and focus on its ten most popular dishes.
sentences.zh: 餐廳決定精簡菜單，專心做最受歡迎的十道菜。

words.note: 語塊：trim costs／the budget（削減成本／預算）、trim the bushes／hedges（修剪灌木／樹籬）、trim your hair（修頭髮）、trim the menu／report（精簡菜單／報告）。和 cut 的差別：cut 可以剪很多；trim 是「稍微剪掉一點、修整」。商業上 trim costs 比 cut costs 語氣溫和。

words.meaning: （銷售、經濟的）衰退；低迷；（表現）低潮

sentences.en: After a prolonged slump in sales, the electronics company finally reported a small profit this quarter.
sentences.zh: 經過長期的銷售低迷，這家電子公司這一季終於有了小額獲利。

sentences.en: The housing market has been in a slump for almost two years because of high interest rates.
sentences.zh: 因為利率很高，房市已經低迷將近兩年了。

sentences.en: Tourism in the region suffered a sharp slump after the airport was closed for repairs.
sentences.zh: 機場關閉整修後，這個地區的觀光業大幅衰退。

sentences.en: Many small shops struggled to survive the economic slump that followed the closure of three large factories in town.
sentences.zh: 鎮上三間大工廠關閉後經濟衰退，很多小店都很難撐下去。

sentences.en: The coach believes the team will recover from its slump once the injured players return.
sentences.zh: 教練相信受傷的球員回來後，球隊就能走出低潮。

words.note: 語塊：prolonged slump（長期低迷）、sales slump（銷售下滑）、economic slump（經濟衰退）、in a slump（處於低潮）、recover from a slump（走出低潮）。slump 也可以當動詞：Sales slumped（銷量大跌）。相近：decline（下降）、recession（經濟衰退，比較正式、規模大）。

words.meaning: 長期的；持續很久的；延長的

sentences.en: The prolonged heat wave caused electricity demand across the city to reach a record high last week.
sentences.zh: 持續很久的熱浪，讓全市上週的用電量創下新高。

sentences.en: After a prolonged period of negotiations, the two companies finally agreed on the terms of the merger.
sentences.zh: 經過很長一段時間的談判，兩家公司終於談妥合併條件。

sentences.en: Prolonged use of the machine without breaks may cause it to overheat and stop working.
sentences.zh: 機器長時間連續使用不休息，可能會過熱而停止運作。

sentences.en: The airline apologized for the prolonged delay and offered every passenger a free meal voucher.
sentences.zh: 航空公司為長時間的延誤道歉，並給每位乘客一張免費餐券。

sentences.en: Doctors warn that prolonged exposure to loud noise in factories can slowly damage workers' hearing over time.
sentences.zh: 醫生警告，在工廠長期暴露在噪音中，會慢慢傷害工人的聽力。

words.note: 語塊：a prolonged period（很長一段時間）、prolonged slump（長期低迷）、prolonged delay（長時間延誤）、prolonged exposure／use（長期暴露／使用）。動詞 prolong（延長）。pro（往前）＋long（長）＝拉長。和 long 的差別：prolonged 強調「比預期或正常的更久」，常帶負面感覺。

words.meaning: 連環車禍；（工作、東西的）堆積

sentences.en: A ten-car pileup on the highway this morning caused long delays for commuters heading into the city.
sentences.zh: 今天早上高速公路發生十車連環車禍，讓進城的通勤族塞了很久。

sentences.en: Heavy fog was the main cause of the multi-car pileup near the airport exit last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚機場出口附近的連環車禍，主要原因是濃霧。

sentences.en: Because of the holiday, there was a pileup of orders that took our warehouse staff three days to process.
sentences.zh: 因為連假，訂單堆積如山，倉庫員工花了三天才處理完。

sentences.en: Drivers are advised to slow down in rainy weather to avoid a dangerous pileup on the freeway.
sentences.zh: 建議駕駛下雨天減速，避免在高速公路發生危險的連環車禍。

sentences.en: The pileup of unanswered emails grew quickly while Mr. Lin was on vacation for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 林先生休假兩週期間，沒回的電子郵件很快就堆成一大堆。

words.note: 語塊：a multi-car／ten-car pileup（多車／十車連環車禍）、a pileup on the highway（高速公路連環撞）、a pileup of work／orders（工作／訂單堆積）。來自片語 pile up（堆起來）。也可以寫成 pile-up。

sentences.en: The company raised its prices slightly to offset the higher cost of raw materials this year.
sentences.zh: 公司稍微調漲價格，來抵銷今年原料成本的上漲。

sentences.en: Strong online sales helped offset the losses caused by the closure of two physical stores downtown.
sentences.zh: 網路銷售很好，幫忙彌補了市區兩家實體店關閉造成的損失。

sentences.en: The higher rent was partly offset by savings on electricity in the new energy-efficient office.
sentences.zh: 新的節能辦公室省下的電費，抵銷了一部分較高的房租。

sentences.en: Our airline lets passengers pay a small fee to offset the carbon emissions from their flights.
sentences.zh: 我們航空公司讓乘客付一點費用，來抵銷飛行產生的碳排放。

sentences.en: The bonus is meant to offset the extra hours that employees worked during the busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 這筆獎金是為了補償員工在忙碌的假期旺季多工作的時數。

words.note: 語塊：offset the cost(s)／losses（抵銷成本／損失）、be offset by＋東西（被……抵銷）、offset carbon emissions（碳抵銷）。三態都一樣：offset–offset–offset。同義詞：make up for、compensate for（補償）。

sentences.en: Our airline offers several domestic flights every day between Taipei and Kaohsiung for business travelers.
sentences.zh: 我們航空公司每天都有好幾班台北和高雄之間的國內航班，供商務旅客搭乘。

sentences.en: The company plans to expand into overseas markets after strong growth in the domestic market last year.
sentences.zh: 公司去年在國內市場成長強勁，之後打算擴展到海外市場。

sentences.en: Rising fuel prices have made domestic travel more expensive for families during the summer holidays.
sentences.zh: 油價上漲讓家庭在暑假期間的國內旅遊變得更貴。

sentences.en: Most of our raw materials come from domestic suppliers, which helps us keep shipping costs low.
sentences.zh: 我們大部分的原料來自國內供應商，這幫助我們壓低運費。

sentences.en: The new hotel provides domestic help, such as cleaning and laundry, for guests who stay longer than a week.
sentences.zh: 新飯店為住超過一週的客人提供家務服務，像是打掃和洗衣。

words.note: 語塊：domestic flights（國內航班）、the domestic market（國內市場）、domestic travel（國內旅遊）。domestic 有兩個主要意思：①國內的（反義詞 international／overseas 國外的）②家庭的、家務的（domestic chores 家事）。多益最常考「國內的」。

sentences.en: The delay in shipping was partially caused by the heavy snow that closed several major roads last week.
sentences.zh: 出貨延誤有一部分是因為上週大雪封閉了好幾條主要道路。

sentences.en: The new parking garage is partially funded by the city government, and the rest comes from private investors.
sentences.zh: 新的停車場部分由市政府出資，其餘來自民間投資人。

sentences.en: The conference room will remain partially closed until the new lighting system is installed next Monday.
sentences.zh: 在下週一新照明系統裝好之前，會議室會維持部分關閉。

sentences.en: The supplier admitted that it was partially responsible for the damaged goods and offered us a discount.
sentences.zh: 供應商承認貨物損壞他們要負部分責任，並給了我們折扣。

sentences.en: The report was only partially completed when the manager asked the team to present their findings.
sentences.zh: 經理要團隊報告結果時，報告只完成了一部分。

words.note: 語塊：be partially responsible for（要負部分責任）、partially caused by（部分是因為……）、partially funded by（部分由……出資）、partially completed（完成了一部分）。容易搞混：particularly（特別地）拼法很像但意思完全不同。partly 跟 partially 意思差不多，口語比較常用 partly。

sentences.en: Many travelers book their tickets early because airfares usually rise sharply during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 很多旅客提早訂票，因為假期期間機票價格通常會大漲。

sentences.en: The travel agency compares airfares from several airlines to find the cheapest option for our sales team.
sentences.zh: 旅行社會比較好幾家航空公司的票價，幫我們業務團隊找最便宜的選擇。

sentences.en: Higher fuel costs have pushed up airfares on most international routes since the beginning of the year.
sentences.zh: 從年初開始，燃料成本上升已經讓大多數國際航線的機票價格上漲。

sentences.en: Our company will cover airfares and hotel costs for all employees attending the conference in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 公司會負擔所有參加東京會議員工的機票和飯店費用。

sentences.en: Because of strong competition between budget carriers, airfares to Bangkok have dropped noticeably this month.
sentences.zh: 因為廉價航空之間競爭激烈，這個月飛曼谷的機票價格明顯下降了。

words.note: 語塊：compare airfares（比較機票價格）、airfares rise／drop（機票漲價／降價）、cover airfares（負擔機票費用）。airfare 是「機票的價錢」，不是機票本身；機票本身是 plane ticket。fare 是交通工具的「票價」，例如 bus fare（公車票價）、taxi fare（計程車費）。

sentences.en: All staff at the front desk are required to wear black patent leather shoes as part of the hotel uniform.
sentences.zh: 飯店櫃台所有員工都必須穿黑色漆皮鞋，這是制服的一部分。

sentences.en: The store displayed a new line of patent leather handbags near the entrance to attract holiday shoppers.
sentences.zh: 店家在入口附近展示新系列的漆皮手提包，吸引假期購物的顧客。

sentences.en: Our engineering team decided to apply for a patent on the new battery design before showing it to investors.
sentences.zh: 我們的工程團隊決定在給投資人看之前，先為新的電池設計申請專利。

sentences.en: The company currently holds a patent for the cooling technology used in most of its laptops.
sentences.zh: 公司目前擁有大部分筆電使用的散熱技術專利。

sentences.en: The government granted the startup a patent last month, which will protect its invention for twenty years.
sentences.zh: 政府上個月核准了這家新創公司的專利，能保護它的發明二十年。

words.note: 語塊：patent leather（漆皮，表面亮亮的皮革）、apply for a patent（申請專利）、hold a patent（擁有專利）。patent 最常見的意思是「專利」；patent leather 是固定說法，指亮面漆皮。小心拼法很像的 patient（病人；有耐心的）和 parent（父母）。

words.meaning: 提交的文件；投稿；申請件

sentences.en: The committee will accept submissions for the annual design contest until the end of next month.
sentences.zh: 委員會會收年度設計比賽的投稿，收到下個月底為止。

sentences.en: All submissions must include a short summary and the applicant's contact information on the first page.
sentences.zh: 所有提交的文件第一頁都必須附上簡短摘要和申請人的聯絡資料。

sentences.en: The deadline for submissions has been extended by one week because of problems with the online system.
sentences.zh: 因為線上系統出了問題，提交截止日延後了一週。

sentences.en: We received more than two hundred submissions for the new logo after announcing the competition on social media.
sentences.zh: 在社群媒體上宣布比賽後，我們收到超過兩百件新標誌的投稿。

sentences.en: The editors review all submissions carefully and will contact the selected writers by email next Friday.
sentences.zh: 編輯會仔細審閱所有投稿，並在下週五用電子郵件聯絡入選的作者。

words.note: 語塊：accept submissions（接受投稿／提交）、the deadline for submissions（提交截止日）、receive submissions（收到投稿）。動詞是 submit（提交），例如 submit a report（交報告）。容易搞混：commission（佣金）、admission（入場；入學）、permission（許可），字尾一樣但意思不同。

sentences.en: Please include your previous work experience and any professional licenses, if applicable, in the application form.
sentences.zh: 請在申請表上填寫你過去的工作經驗，如果有的話，也附上專業證照。

sentences.en: The new safety rules are applicable to all employees who work in the warehouse or loading area.
sentences.zh: 新的安全規定適用於所有在倉庫或裝卸區工作的員工。

sentences.en: Please attach a copy of your university diploma, if applicable, when you send us your résumé next week.
sentences.zh: 下週寄履歷給我們時，如果有的話，請附上大學畢業證書影本。

sentences.en: Customers must pay all applicable taxes and fees when they purchase products from our online store.
sentences.zh: 顧客在我們網路商店購買商品時，必須支付所有適用的稅金。

sentences.en: The manager explained that the travel policy is not applicable to short trips within the city.
sentences.zh: 經理解釋，差旅規定不適用於市區內的短程出差。

words.note: 語塊：if applicable（如果適用的話；如有的話）、be applicable to（適用於……）、applicable taxes／fees（相關的稅金／費用）。表格上常看到 if applicable，意思是「有的話才填，沒有就不用填」。和 available（可用的、有空的）不一樣：applicable 是「規定或條件適用」。

sentences.en: New employees will be paid according to the following pay scale, which is based on experience and education.
sentences.zh: 新進員工會依照以下的薪資等級表支薪，依據經驗和學歷而定。

sentences.en: The company reviews its pay scale every year to make sure salaries remain competitive in the industry.
sentences.zh: 公司每年都會檢討薪資級距，確保薪水在業界保有競爭力。

sentences.en: Our factory plans to increase production on a large scale once the new machines arrive in March.
sentences.zh: 新機器三月到貨後，我們工廠打算大規模增加產量。

sentences.en: Customers were asked to rate the service on a scale of one to ten after their hotel stay.
sentences.zh: 顧客退房後被請求用一到十分來評分服務。

sentences.en: Because of budget limits, the marketing team decided to scale back the advertising campaign this quarter.
sentences.zh: 因為預算有限，行銷團隊決定這一季縮減廣告活動的規模。

words.note: 語塊：pay scale／salary scale（薪資等級表）、on a large scale（大規模地）、on a scale of 1 to 10（用1到10分來評）、scale back（縮減規模）。scale 還有「體重計、秤」的意思（bathroom scale）。和 scope（範圍）不同：scale 是「規模、等級」，scope 是「涵蓋的範圍」。

sentences.en: A one-year subscription to our business magazine includes twelve issues delivered directly to your office.
sentences.zh: 我們商業雜誌的一年訂閱包含十二期，直接寄到你的辦公室。

sentences.en: Subscribers can also read all the back issues of the magazine on our website at no extra charge.
sentences.zh: 訂閱者也可以免費在網路上閱讀雜誌的過期刊物。

sentences.en: The technical support team quickly resolved the issues that customers reported with the new software update.
sentences.zh: 技術支援團隊很快就解決了顧客回報的新軟體更新問題。

sentences.en: Please contact the human resources department if you have any issues with your monthly paycheck.
sentences.zh: 如果你的月薪有任何問題，請聯絡人資部門。

sentences.en: The upcoming issues of the newsletter will focus on ways to reduce energy use in the office.
sentences.zh: 接下來幾期的電子報會著重在辦公室節能的方法。

words.note: 語塊：12 issues（12期）、back issues（過期刊物）、resolve issues（解決問題）、have issues with（……有問題）。issue 在雜誌、報紙情境是「期」，例如 the latest issue（最新一期）；在辦公室情境常是「問題、議題」，比 problem 委婉。也可以當動詞：issue a statement（發表聲明）、issue a refund（核發退款）。

sentences.en: Subscriptions to the design magazine cost sixty dollars and include twelve issues annually, delivered by mail.
sentences.zh: 設計雜誌的訂閱費用是六十元，每年有十二期，用郵寄送達。

sentences.en: The company holds its shareholder meeting annually in the main conference hall at its headquarters.
sentences.zh: 公司每年在總部的大會議廳召開一次股東大會。

sentences.en: Employee performance is reviewed annually, and salary increases are based on the results of the review.
sentences.zh: 員工表現每年考核一次，加薪是根據考核結果決定的。

sentences.en: The award is presented annually to the sales representative with the highest customer satisfaction rating.
sentences.zh: 這個獎每年頒給顧客滿意度最高的業務代表。

sentences.en: Our software license must be renewed annually, so please remind the IT department before December.
sentences.zh: 我們的軟體授權每年都要續約，所以請在十二月前提醒資訊部門。

words.note: 語塊：twelve issues annually（每年十二期）、be reviewed annually（每年考核一次）、be renewed annually（每年續約）、be held annually（每年舉辦）。形容詞是 annual（每年的），例如 annual report（年報）。類似：monthly（每月）、weekly（每週）、quarterly（每季）。

words.meaning: 未經請求的；主動提供的；不請自來的

sentences.en: Our email system automatically moves unsolicited emails from unknown senders into a separate spam folder.
sentences.zh: 我們的電子郵件系統會自動把陌生寄件人主動寄來的信件移到垃圾郵件匣。

sentences.en: The magazine does not accept unsolicited manuscripts, so writers must first send a short proposal to the editor.
sentences.zh: 這本雜誌不接受未經邀約的投稿，所以作者必須先寄簡短的提案給編輯。

sentences.en: Employees should not give unsolicited advice to clients about matters outside their own area of expertise.
sentences.zh: 員工不應該在自己專業以外的事情上，主動給客戶沒被要求的建議。

sentences.en: The company received several unsolicited job applications after its new office opened in the business district.
sentences.zh: 公司在商業區開了新辦公室後，收到好幾份主動投遞的求職申請。

sentences.en: Customers can call this number if they wish to stop receiving unsolicited calls from our marketing department.
sentences.zh: 如果顧客不想再接到我們行銷部門主動打去的電話，可以撥打這支電話。

words.note: 語塊：unsolicited emails／calls（垃圾信件／推銷電話）、unsolicited advice（沒人要求的建議）、unsolicited manuscripts／applications（主動投稿／主動投遞的履歷）。un（不）＋solicited（被請求的）＝沒人請你、自己主動來的。動詞 solicit 是「請求、徵求」，例如 solicit feedback（徵求意見）。

sentences.en: The client requested a revision to the contract because the delivery date was listed incorrectly.
sentences.zh: 客戶要求修改合約，因為交貨日期寫錯了。

sentences.en: The design team made a minor revision to the logo after receiving feedback from the marketing director.
sentences.zh: 設計團隊收到行銷總監的意見後，對標誌做了小幅修改。

sentences.en: The budget proposal is still under revision and will be sent to the board of directors next week.
sentences.zh: 預算提案還在修改中，下週會送交董事會。

sentences.en: Each revision of the user manual must be approved by the quality control manager before it is printed.
sentences.zh: 使用手冊每次修訂都必須經過品管經理核准才能印刷。

sentences.en: After a careful revision of last year's sales figures, the accountant found several small errors in the report.
sentences.zh: 仔細重新檢查去年的銷售數字後，會計發現報告裡有幾個小錯誤。

words.note: 語塊：make a revision to（對……做修改）、request a revision（要求修改）、under revision（修改中）、minor／major revision（小幅／大幅修改）。動詞是 revise（修改、修訂）。容易搞混：provision（提供；條款）、division（部門；分配）拼法很像但意思不同。英式英文的 revision 也有「複習（考試）」的意思。

words.meaning: 匯款；繳納（remit 的過去式／過去分詞）

sentences.en: Payment will be remitted to your bank account within thirty days after we receive the signed invoice.
sentences.zh: 收到簽名的發票後，款項會在三十天內匯到你的銀行帳戶。

sentences.en: The supplier confirmed that the full payment was remitted by wire transfer on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 供應商確認全額款項已在週一早上透過電匯付出。

sentences.en: All taxes collected from customers must be remitted to the government by the fifteenth of each month.
sentences.zh: 向顧客收取的所有稅金，都必須在每個月十五號前繳交給政府。

sentences.en: The freelance writer was remitted her fee only after the editor approved the final version of the article.
sentences.zh: 編輯核准文章定稿之後，自由撰稿人才收到她的稿費。

sentences.en: Once the funds are remitted, the accounting department will send you a receipt by email.
sentences.zh: 款項匯出後，會計部門會用電子郵件寄收據給你。

words.note: 語塊：payment will be remitted（款項將會匯出）、remit payment（匯款；付款）、be remitted to＋帳戶／對象（匯給……）。原形是 remit（匯款、繳納），名詞 remittance（匯款）。比 pay 或 send money 更正式，常出現在發票和合約上。容易搞混：admitted（承認了）、permitted（允許了）、omitted（省略了）。

notes.note: 意思像 make（讓某人去做某事），但句型不同：prompt + 人 + to + 動詞（The rain prompted us to stay home.）；make + 人 + 動詞原形，不加 to（The rain made us stay home.）。make 較口語、帶「不得不」的感覺；prompt 較正式，指某件事成為原因、讓人決定去做。prompt 當形容詞是「迅速的」（a prompt reply）；放在名詞前通常是形容詞，後面接「人 + to + 動詞」就是動詞「促使」。

語塊：outgoing／friendly personality（外向／親切的個性）、strong personality（個性很強）、personality traits（人格特質）。personality 也可以指「名人」（可數）：a TV personality（電視名人）、a well-known personality（知名人物）、a radio personality（電台主持人）。和 character 的差別：personality 偏外在個性，character 偏品格。別搞混 personnel（全體員工、人事）。
